item.title: Bolsas asiáticas repuntan mientras inversores buscan oportunidades tras la venta masiva por la IA
item.description: Las acciones de semiconductores recuperan terreno, mientras crece la preocupación por la deuda que financia la infraestructura de IA y los inversores evalúan una rotación hacia sectores menos expuesto ...
item.dc:creator: Anand Krishnamoorthy
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Las bolsas asiáticas subieron, siguiendo la tendencia alcista de Wall Street, a medida que los compradores aprovecharon las caídas tras la venta masiva de acciones de semiconductores, impulsada por la preocupación sobre el sector de la inteligencia artificial. El índice MSCI Asia Pacífico avanzó un 0,6%, impulsado por las acciones de Corea del Sur. Las acciones de semiconductores subieron, con Samsung Electronics Co. y SK Hynix Inc. ( SKHY ) registrando ligeros alzas. Anteriormente, el S&P 500 recuperó terreno y cerró el jueves con un alza del 0,3%. Predominó la cautela mientras los contratos de referencia estadounidenses registraban ligeros descensos al inicio de la sesión asiática. Los futuros del índice Nasdaq 100 cayeron un 0,5%. El jueves, los recibos de depósito estadounidenses de Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. ( TSM ) cayeron un 1,8% después de que sus optimistas perspectivas no lograran disipar las preocupaciones sobre el desarrollo de la IA. Ver más: Wall Street rebota y el Dow Jones lidera las ganancias ante las dudas sobre inversiones en IA Los bonos del Tesoro repuntaron ante la demanda de activos refugio, impulsada por las fuertes fluctuaciones de los mercados bursátiles y crediticios mundiales esta semana. El rendimiento del bono de referencia a 10 años cayó 13 puntos básicos, hasta el 5,06%, durante la sesión de Nueva York. Los futuros del Tesoro registraron un ligero alza el viernes, coincidiendo con la reunión informal que el presidente de la Reserva Federal, Kevin Warsh, mantendría con la directora gerente del FMI, Kristalina Georgieva, en Bangkok. Las acciones indonesias estarán en el punto de mira tras la posible exclusión del país de los índices bursátiles mundiales. Los inversores también seguirán de cerca los mercados chinos, dado que la Unión Europea se prepara para crear nuevas competencias comerciales que podrían restringir por completo el acceso a su mercado único, en el marco de una nueva y drástica iniciativa para reducir el déficit comercial con China. Ahora la atención se centra en si el repunte de las acciones podrá extenderse tras la caída que puso de manifiesto la creciente inquietud por la fuerte concentración de ganancias en acciones vinculadas a la IA. Los indicios de una rotación hacia otros sectores del mercado podrían brindar a las acciones una base más sólida después de meses en los que las acciones tecnológicas dominaron la rentabilidad. Ver más: HSBC adoptará el modelo de bonos de Wall Street y eliminará prestaciones fijas a directivos “Tras el fuerte repunte de las acciones de IA en los últimos meses, las acciones de valor se abarataron demasiado, mientras que las tecnológicas se encarecieron considerablemente en medio del frenesí por la inteligencia artificial”, declaró Brian Frank, presidente y gestor de cartera de Frank Funds. “Seguimos buscando empresas con buena solvencia y que coticen con descuento, en caso de que el crecimiento o el gasto de los consumidores disminuyan debido a una inflación persistente”. Ya se vislumbraban indicios de un cambio más amplio en Wall Street. Una versión ponderada equitativamente del índice S&P 500 subió un 1,4%, con las acciones de atención médica y bienes de consumo básico liderando las ganancias. Ver más: Wall Street ve margen para más ganancias en el S&P 500: las 5 acciones con mayor potencial al alza La presión sobre las acciones de semiconductores disminuyó después de que el CEO de Nvidia Corp. ( NVDA ), Jensen Huang, defendiera la solidez financiera del proveedor de computación para IA CoreWeave Inc. ( CRWV ). Las acciones de la compañía subieron un 4%, tras una caída del 12% en la sesión anterior. El índice de semiconductores de Filadelfia redujo sus pérdidas a menos del 1%, después de haber caído hasta un 4,4%. “La solidez de CoreWeave mejora día a día”, declaró Huang a Bloomberg en un evento celebrado el jueves en Estocolmo. “Soy optimista. Su coste de capital está disminuyendo”. En otros segmentos del mercado, el dólar se debilitó, mientras que el oro subió en la última sesión. El petróleo crudo estadounidense bajó ligeramente el viernes, situándose en torno a los US$97,50 por barril. Ver más: Wall Street vuelve a plantearse la posibilidad de eliminar el bono del Tesoro de EE.UU. a 20 años Mientras tanto, las dudas sobre la durabilidad del auge de la inversión en IA se están extendiendo a los mercados crediticios, a medida que los inversores examinan detenidamente la deuda que financia el desarrollo de infraestructuras. Un indicador del riesgo crediticio de CoreWeave alcanzó un máximo histórico el jueves, a medida que algunos de sus bonos de alto rendimiento prolongaban sus caídas. En Warsh, los operadores buscarán indicios sobre si los funcionarios de la Reserva Federal se inclinan por otra subida de tasas. El mes pasado, la Reserva Federal aumentó los costes de endeudamiento por primera vez desde 2023, y los futuros ahora sugieren una probabilidad de alrededor del 25% de una subida de tasas en octubre. Ver más: Goldman ve un futuro incierto para los mandos intermedios de Wall Street ante el avance de la IA “En general, creemos que Warsh se expresará de una manera que no sugiera una subida de tasas en octubre”, dijo Krishna Guha de Evercore. “Warsh tendrá en cuenta la inestabilidad global de las acciones tecnológicas y las señales de que las condiciones de financiación se están endureciendo para las empresas de IA más expuestas, además del repunte previo de los rendimientos a largo plazo”. Este reportaje se elaboró con la ayuda de Bloomberg Automation. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: テニス＝男子への報酬総額550億円超えに、ランキング制度見直しも
item.description: ［ベンガルール（インド） １５日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ベンガルール（インド）　１５日　ロイター］ - 男子プロテニス協会（ＡＴＰ）は１５日、２０２８年以降に向けた新たな計画を発表。選手への報酬総額が３億５０００万ドル（約５５３億円）に達する見込みであることが分かった。

アンドレア・ガウデンツィ会長が提示した提案によると、男子ツアーのボーナス総額は現在の２１５０万ドルから５０００万ドルに引き上げ。さらに年末時点のランキングでトップ２５０に入った選手向けに２５００万ドルが割り当てられるほか、３００人の選手を対象とした年金制度に年間３０００万ドルが充てられる。

さらに今後の協議と承認を経て、２０２８年以降はＡＴＰが選手に支払う報酬総額は１億ドルを超える見込み。これに賞金や利益分配を加えると、四大大会の賞金を除いた選手への報酬総額は推定３億５０００万ドルに達する見通しとなる。

新計画にはランキング制度および年間スケジュールの見直しも含まれており、ＡＴＰは主要大会における成績がランキングに与える影響度を高めていく方針。これにより、大会で振るわなかった選手がポイントを稼ぐために他の大会を転戦する理由を減らすとともに、大会カテゴリーごとに特定の週を割り当てることで、ツアー構造をより明確にする狙いがある。

ガウデンツィ会長は今回のＡＴＰの提案について、選手がシーズン計画を立てやすくなり、主要大会での活躍がより適切に報われるようになると述べた。

item.title: ＭＳＣＩ、トルコ株式指数巡る変更凍結 格下げの可能性を警告
item.description:
Mrinmay Dey Rodrigo Campos
[１５日 ロイター] - 世界的な株価指数算出会社ＭＳＣＩは１５...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＭＳＣＩ、トルコ株式指数巡る変更凍結　格下げの可能性を警告 11:22 配信

ＭＳＣＩのロゴ。２０１７年６月撮影。REUTERS/Thomas White

Mrinmay Dey　Rodrigo Campos

[１５日 ロイター] - 世界的な株価指数算出会社ＭＳＣＩは１５日、トルコ株式指数に関する変更を凍結した。市場改革を評価するためにさらなる時間が必要だとし、２０２７年半ばまでに十分な進展が見られない場合は格下げの可能性があると警告した。

トルコの株式市場は、浮動株数の算出方法や、一部の銘柄における協調取引の疑いについて、投資家から厳しい目を向けられている。

ＭＳＣＩの決定により、トルコの「エマージング（新興国）市場」ステータスは維持されるが、将来的に「フロンティア市場」への格下げが行われた場合、「ＭＳＣＩ新興国市場指数」に連動するファンドによる売り圧力が生じる可能性がある。

ＭＳＣＩは、２０２７年６月までに十分な進展が見られない場合、トルコを新興国市場からフロンティアまたは「スタンドアローン」市場へと格下げすることについて協議を行うなど、さらなる措置を講じる可能性があると述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ウォーシュ氏の「沈黙路線」、ＦＲＢ内で反発の声　政策発信重視論も アングル：ＥＵの自動車現地調達ルール案、中国勢は先回りで足場固め アングル：金価格、米国債利回り上昇でも4000ドル台維持　中銀の準備資産分散が下支え アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める 焦点：トルコのエルドアン大統領、ガザ停戦合意仲介で示した存在感 最終更新: 10/16(金) 11:22 ロイター

item.title: Brady Tkachuk caps 2nd straight hat trick in OT as Panthers top Canucks
item.description: Brady Tkachuk scored twice in the final nine minutes of regulation, then completed his second straight natural hat trick 2:23 into overtime, leading the Florida Panthers to a 3-2 come-from-behind victory over the Vancouver Canucks on Thursday in Sunrise, Fla.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Brady Tkachuk scored twice in the final nine minutes of regulation, then completed his second straight natural hat trick 2:23 into overtime, leading the Florida Panthers to a 3-2 come-from-behind victory over the Vancouver Canucks on Thursday in Sunrise, Fla. Tkachuk is the first player since the Toronto Maple Leafs' Auston Matthews in February 2024 to record a hat trick in back-to-back games. He is the third Panther with a hat trick in consecutive games (Noel Acciari and Pavel Bure) and the second to complete a hat trick in overtime (Aleksander Barkov). Panthers goalie Akira Schmid, making his third consecutive appearance and second straight start while Jacob Markstrom remains day-to-day with an undisclosed injury, stopped 15 shots. Seth Jones logged two assists as the Panthers won two straight games for the first time this season. Liam Ohgren and Elias Pettersson scored for Vancouver, which took its sixth loss in a row (0-5-1). Merilainen, who allowed six goals in his previous two outings, was stout throughout the night, finishing with 36 saves as the Canucks dropped to 0-4-1 on a six-game road trip. Down 2-0, Florida began its comeback. Tkachuk, who scored his first three goals with his new team during the Panthers' 7-3 victory at Columbus on Tuesday, sent a one-time wrister past Vancouver goaltender Leevi Merilainen, with 8:49 remaining in the third period. An Aaron Ekblad drop pass set up the tally. With 13 seconds to go in regulation and Schmid pulled for an extra skater, Tkachuk got enough on a bouncing puck to score through traffic. "The Panthers applied pressure from the start of overtime, and Tkachuk ended the game by beating Merilainen from point-blank range. Moments after killing off a Florida power play, the Canucks opened the scoring 7:23 into the first period on their first shot on goal. The Panthers struggled to clear their zone, and the puck found the stick of Vancouver's Linus Karlsson, who sent it into the slot for Ohgren to one-time past Schmid. The Canucks, outshot 15-7 through the first 20 minutes, made it 2-0 with 2:54 left in the opening period. Off a side-board scrum for the puck, it got out to Vancouver's Filip Chytil, who sent a back-handed pass into the slot for a wide-open Pettersson to bury. --Field Level Media

item.title: Bank of England's Bailey says second-round inflation pressures look subdued so far
item.description: Soaring energy prices so far appear to be having limited wider effects on British prices, but it is too soon to draw firm conclusions, Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Soaring energy prices so far appear to be having limited wider effects on British prices, but it is too soon to draw firm conclusions, Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey said on Friday. "I think it's too early, but to the extent we've seen evidence, so far it's been quite subdued," he told a meeting of the Institute of International Finance, an industry association, in Bangkok. The IIF meetings are taking place on the sidelines of the annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank.

item.title: Victor Hedman's OT winner gives Lightning 4th straight home win
item.description: Tampa Bay's Victor Hedman drove through the slot and scored at 2:07 of overtime as the Lightning beat the Seattle Kraken 4-3 on Thursday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Tampa Bay's Victor Hedman drove through the slot and scored at 2:07 of overtime as the Lightning beat the Seattle Kraken 4-3 on Thursday night. The captain appeared to lose control of the puck while splitting the defense, but he lunged forward and swatted it past Grubauer for his first goal of the season. The Lightning improved to 4-0-0 at home this season. Brandon Hagel potted two goals and Ilya Mikheyev notched his 100th career tally. Goaltender Andrei Vasilevskiy made 24 saves. All-time, the Lightning are 9-0-2 against the Kraken, while Vasilevskiy improved to 8-0-1 against them. Dominic James (hand) made his season debut after breaking his hand in September and recorded an assist. Seattle's Matty Beniers registered his 200th career point with a goal, and Ryan Winterton and Jared McCann hit the net. Seattle goaltender Philipp Grubauer stopped 31 shots as the club slipped to 3-0-1 on its five-game road trip. Vasilevskiy left the puck behind the net for Emil Lilleberg, but Frederick Gaudreau pressured the defenseman and sent the puck in front to Winterton, who backhanded it home for his second goal of the season at 5:43. After taking a pass from Brayden Point, Hagel skated through the right circle and fired a shot into Grubauer's chest, then knocked in his own rebound to tie the game at 16:53. Hagel ripped a nasty snipe past Grubauer at 3:38 in the second for his sixth goal, and the Lightning's penalty-kill units killed off Seattle's consecutive power plays. Vasilevskiy made the one-goal lead stand up by denying Shane Wright on a point-blank chance with 43 seconds left. However, James committed an interference penalty inside the first three minutes of the third. McCann scored for the third time this season when he finished a slick feed from Jordan Eberle just seven seconds into the power play at 2:54. The home side forced a turnover behind Grubauer midway through the third, and Mikheyev batted in the puck to reach the century mark for the go-ahead goal. Beniers knotted it 3-all when he tipped in his second goal over Vasilevskiy at 15:41 on a long shot by Vince Dunn. --Field Level Media

item.title: 中南米の輸出、アジア向け転換進む 米関税政策で貿易再編＝国連
item.description: [サンティアゴ １５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[サンティアゴ １５日 ロイター] - 国連中南米・カリブ経済委員会（ＥＣＬＡＣ）が１５日公表した年次報告書によると、中南米・カリブ地域でアジア向け輸出が拡大している。トランプ米大統領の広範な関税政策で世界貿易が一変し、輸出先の転換が進んでいるという。

・報告書は、中南米の輸出はアジアの貿易相手国向けへと大幅な再編が進んでいると指摘した。

・２６年上半期は、同地域のモノとサービスの貿易が大幅に拡大。輸出は前年同期比１８％、輸入は同１３％それぞれ増加した。

・上半期も、米国が中南米・カリブ地域の輸出拡大で主要なけん引役の一つとなった。

・世界的な重要鉱物需要の拡大とサプライチェーン（供給網）の再編が、中南米の国際経済統合強化に向けた好機となっている。

・報告書は「主な課題は、原材料の輸出拡大にとどまらず、こうした資源を活用し、革新や技術開発に結び付いた、より付加価値の高い活動を促進することだ」と指摘した。

item.title: Investors see outflow and FX risks as MSCI moves to downgrade Indonesia
item.description: Indonesia's stock market is no longer worthy of "emerging market" status, MSCI said, and the index provider proposed to cut it from a suite of products tracked by global investors.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Indonesia's stock market is no longer worthy of "emerging market" status, [USN:L4N46124S TEXT:"MSCI said"], and the index provider proposed to cut it from a suite of products tracked by global investors. The move is a major setback likely to send money fleeing. Here is what market participants are saying: ANGUS MACKINTOSH, ASEAN SPECIALIST, ALETHIA CAPITAL, SINGAPORE: "The move seems heavy-handed given the moves that Indonesia has made to address issues around market visibility and free float. The problem for Indonesia is a lack of evidence of implementation and a failure to sanction those obviously involved in stock manipulation. The only way for Indonesia to remedy this situation would be to impose severe sanctions and fines on those involved in concerted share manipulation. "This move does not reflect the health of the vast majority of listed companies or indeed the Indonesian economy, and grouping Indonesia with Lebanon, Palestine, and Argentina does not make sense." RADHIKA RAO, SENIOR ECONOMIST, DBS BANK, SINGAPORE: "This potential development could prove more unfavourable than a tier reclassification, as passive investors bound by mandate may also reduce exposure. Any ensuing risk-off move in the currency would likely prompt greater central bank vigilance and intervention." GARY TAN, PORTFOLIO MANAGER, ALLSPRING GLOBAL INVESTMENTS, SINGAPORE: "The consultation is a surprise given the steps Indonesia has already taken to improve market accessibility, including removing the minimum share price limit. The prospect of standalone status could encourage index-linked investors to further de-risk, but for Indonesia in our view the bigger concern is less the direct impact on equities and more the potential pressure on the currency from foreign outflows." IRMAN FAIZ, ECONOMIST, BANK DANAMON INDONESIA: "MSCI's unusually strong assessment increases the incentive for institutional investors to reduce exposure ahead of the final decision, potentially extending equity volatility and weakening foreign risk appetite. "The larger risk is structural from a reduced institutional participation, thinner liquidity, to higher equity financing costs. Large-cap banks are particularly exposed, while spillovers into sovereign bonds would depend on broader investor risk appetite rather than automatic index-related selling." JAYDEN VANTARAKIS, HEAD OF ASEAN EQUITY RESEARCH, MACQUARIE CAPITAL, SINGAPORE: "The working assumption for most equity investors we’d spoken with recently had been that steps taken on free-floats and shareholder concentration disclosure would be sufficient to avert a downgrade." "The extension of the review from November 2026 to June 2027 also prolongs the period of uncertainty for investors."

item.title: Owen Power completes Sabres' comeback with OT winner vs. Leafs
item.description: Owen Power scored in overtime as the visiting Buffalo Sabres came from behind to top the Toronto Maple Leafs 5-4 on Thursday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Owen Power scored in overtime as the visiting Buffalo Sabres came from behind to top the Toronto Maple Leafs 5-4 on Thursday night. Power nabbed his second overtime winner of the season, receiving a pass from Jack Quinn and launching it past goaltender Sergei Bobrovsky blocker side. Quinn recorded four points and a Gordie Howe hat trick for the Sabres after a second-period tussle with Troy Stecher. Mattias Samuelsson, Noah Ostlund and Zach Benson had multi-point games for Buffalo, and Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen made 26 saves in his third win of the season. Kirill Marchenko scored a hat trick for Toronto. John Tavares had two assists but went to the dressing room in the third period after a collision with Josh Norris. The Sabres have won four of their last five against Toronto. Buffalo trailed 4-2 after two periods, but about halfway through the third Dennis Gilbert brought his team within one off a low shot from the point. It was the fourth goal of the journeyman defenseman's career and his first since 2023. Samuelsson tied the game two minutes later off a give-and-go with Tage Thompson. Toronto was outshot 11-4 in the third. Auston Matthews plucked Samuelsson's clearing attempt out of the air and left the puck for Jack Roslovic, who played it back to the captain making a beeline towards the net. Matthews flipped the puck past a helpless Luukkonen to open the scoring in the early going, extending his points streak to six games. Quinn tied it up just over a minute later, Benson snatching the puck off Nick Blankenburg and slipping the puck to Quinn in the slot. Marchenko put the home team back in the lead with a highlight-reel goal on the power play, pulling the puck through his legs and lifting it over Luukkonen in tight. Quinn ripped in his second of the game early in the middle frame, dragging the puck around the stick of Jake McCabe to wrist it past Bobrovsky from the high slot. Sitting on a hat trick, Quinn proceeded to strike iron twice in the second period. Marchenko flicked in his second of the game from the edge of the faceoff circle to put the Maple Leafs up 3-2. Colton Sissons helped him to a hat trick five minutes later with a slick feed from behind the goal line, Marchenko firing it in off a one-timer from close range. --Field Level Media

item.title: AI selloff hammers hedge funds this week, Asia managers lead losses
item.description: Global hedge funds suffered steep losses this week, according to a Goldman Sachs prime brokerage note, battered by the violent unwind of a swathe of AI bets, with Asia-focused funds hit the hardest.
item.dc:creator: Summer Zhen, Anirban Sen
item.content:encoded: Global hedge funds suffered steep losses this week, according to a Goldman Sachs prime brokerage note, battered by the violent unwind of a swathe of AI bets, with Asia-focused funds hit the hardest. Investors are increasingly [USN:L1N45Z05C TEXT:"questioning"] whether massive AI spending can [USN:L6N46118I TEXT:"pay off"] anytime soon as elevated inflation keeps borrowing costs high. Global fundamental long-short funds, or stock pickers, lost money every single day this week, Goldman Sachs said, with losses for the week to October 15 coming to 2.9%. For the year to date, though, they have gains of 14.3%. On Wednesday, hedge funds across strategies retreated sharply, with stock pickers globally losing 0.9%. Among them, Asia-focused managers were down 2.6%, while tech-focused funds were off 2.0%. Global systematic long-short managers and multi-strategy funds also declined roughly 1%. Hotter-than-expected US inflation data this week that increased expectations of further rate hikes also fuelled the selloff in semiconductor and AI supply chain stocks. "From COVID through end-2025, all three broad strategies never fell more than 80bps on the same day," Goldman Sachs said, adding that this has now occurred three times this year, on February 4, July 28 and October 15. Semiconductor-heavy markets bore the brunt of the selloff. South Korea's benchmark KOSPI (.KS11) tumbled 8% to close at a six-month low on Thursday, while Taiwan stocks also lost more than 3%. Asia-focused stock pickers have lost 6.8% for the first half of this month and have erased more than half of the gains from their late-June peak, when they were up more than 40% for the year, according to Goldman Sachs.

item.title: Shane Pinto lifts Senators past Islanders in shootout
item.description: Shane Pinto scored the only goal in the shootout Thursday night for the host Ottawa Senators, who outlasted the New York Islanders 2-1.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Shane Pinto scored the only goal in the shootout Thursday night for the host Ottawa Senators, who outlasted the New York Islanders 2-1. Pinto, the Senators' third skater in the shootout, shuffled the puck as he approached Islanders goalie Semyon Varlamov before sending a shot beyond Varlamov's glove. Ottawa goalie Linus Ullmark then stopped New York's Simon Holmstrom to seal the win. Ridly Greig scored in the second for the Senators, who have won six of their first eight games (6-2-0). Ullmark made 20 saves in regulation and overtime. Matias Maccelli scored for the second straight game for the Islanders, who have alternated wins and losses in their first seven contests (3-3-1). Varlamov, seeking his first win since Nov. 14, 2024, made 18 saves. The 38-year-old missed last season while recovering from double partial knee replacements. The Senators had two potential first-period goals overturned on video review before Maccelli put New York ahead with an unassisted tally with 11.2 seconds remaining. Warren Foegele appeared to give Ottawa the lead 4:50 into the game, but the puck slid along the goal line without fully crossing it. The Islanders' challenge was successful with 8:06 left, when Stephen Halliday's goal was disallowed after a review showed the Senators were offside. Maccelli finally broke the scoreless tie when he stole the puck from Pinto deep in the Ottawa zone, took a couple strides and fired a shot over Ullmark's glove as Islanders center Bo Horvat and Senators defenseman Thomas Chabot skated into the shooting lane. Greig tied the score with 4:17 left in the second. Artem Zub sent a clearing pass from Ottawa's goal line through the neutral zone to Foegele, who threaded a backhanded feed past a sliding Kyle Palmieri. Greig collected the puck and flicked a shot over Varlamov's blocker. Both teams picked up penalties in overtime, but the Islanders killed off Adam Pelech's hooking call at the 1:52 mark and the Senators burned the final 59 seconds after Dylan Cozens was whistled for tripping. --Field Level Media

item.title: Luke Hughes nets 2 goals in Devils' 7-1 domination of Rangers
item.description: Luke Hughes led the way with two of the New Jersey Devils' four second-period goals to help bury their rival New York Rangers 7-1 in Newark, N.J. on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Luke Hughes led the way with two of the New Jersey Devils' four second-period goals to help bury their rival New York Rangers 7-1 in Newark, N.J. on Thursday. Nico Daws stopped 18 shots in the victory, while Nico Hischier, Arseny Gritsyuk, Evan Rodrigues, Cody Glass, and Stefan Noesen all joined Hughes on the scoresheet. Timo Meier, Dougie Hamilton, Brett Pesce, Dawson Mercer, and Amadeus Lombardi all picked up a pair of assists each. Pavel Dorofeyev scored the Rangers' lone goal as they allowed more than three goals for the first time this season. Rodrigues took advantage of a tough giveaway and ripped it past Dylan Garand with 30 seconds remaining in the first period to give the Devils the lead. Hughes fired a point shot that bounced off a defender and snuck through the legs of Garand to double the Devils' advantage just 18 seconds into the middle frame. Hischier then made it 3-0 barely over four minutes into the second. After the Devils captain fired his shot wide on an odd-man rush, he stuck around and poked a rebound past the pad of an outstretched Garand. The Devils kept rolling just 31 seconds later as Gritsyuk made up for a missed breakaway by pouncing on a rebound and lighting the lamp, marking the end of Garand's night after he allowed four goals on 13 shots. Spencer Martin gave up three goals on 18 shots in relief. The youngest Hughes brother showcased his impressive skillset as he walked the blueline and cut in toward the net. He sent a shot off the far post and into the back of the net for his second goal of the night with 3:26 left in the second. Noesen buried his first goal of the season to make it 6-0 with just over seven minutes gone in the third period. Dorofeyev spoiled Daws' shutout bid with a power-play marker just over a minute later. Glass got in on the action to make it 7-1 with just over five minutes left in the contest. --Field Level Media

item.title: 中国、ヨルダン川西岸入植地の建設停止をイスラエルに要求
item.description:
[北京 １６日 ロイター] - 中国外務省は１６日、王毅外相がイスラエルのヘルツォグ大統領に対し、ヨルダン川西岸での入植地建設の「強行」を停止し、撤回すべきだと伝えたと明らかにした。
同省によると、王氏はアゼルバイジャンで行われたヘルツォグ氏との会談で、中国はパレスチナ問題が今世紀最大の歴史的不正義だとの立場を一貫して取ってきたと述べた。
• 王氏は、地域の平和と和解の促進が中国の中東政策の「礎」だと述べた。
• また、中国は「２国家解決」が問題解決への正しい道だと考えており、当面の最優先課題はパレスチナ自治区ガザへのアクセスを全面的に開放し、人道上の「大惨事」が拡大するのを防ぐことだとした。
• 同時に、イスラエルはヨルダン川西岸での入植地建設の強行を停止し、撤回すべきだと述べた。

item.title: White House press secretary Katie Zacharia says she did not pass bar exam
item.description: New White House press secretary Katie Zacharia said on Thursday she did not pass the bar exam after facing scrutiny about her legal career before becoming the top spokeswoman for US President Donald Trump.
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh, Jasper Ward
item.content:encoded: New White House press secretary [USN:L6N4601D0 TEXT:"Katie Zacharia"] said on Thursday she did not pass the bar exam after facing scrutiny about her legal career before becoming the top spokeswoman for US President Donald Trump . Zacharia, who joined the White House on Monday, has previously said she practiced law before entering politics and Trump had described her as an attorney. "You did not pass the bar exam, correct?" she was asked in an interview on Fox News' "Hannity" show late on Thursday. "Correct," she said in response to the host, Sean Hannity. "I did not," she said when Hannity asked if she ever took the bar exam a second time. Zacharia earned her law degree from Pepperdine University in 2011, according to the university. Nearly all licensed US lawyers first obtain a law degree, but law school graduates cannot legally practice law in the US without first being admitted to a state bar. On Tuesday during her first briefing, she took questions from just three reporters before ending the event in under 15 minutes. Her performance was criticized by some media commentators and political analysts, though Trump told reporters, "I thought she was very good." When asked about her performance by Hannity, she said: "What I feel is I really stepped up to the plate to do the press conference, Sean, with very little prep time."

item.title: ＭＳＣＩ、インドネシア株をグローバル指数から除外する意向示す
item.description: [ジャカルタ １６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ジャカルタ １６日 ロイター] - 世界的な株価指数算出会社ＭＳＣＩは１６日、インドネシアの株式市場はもはや「エマージング（新興国）市場」ステータスに値していないとし、グローバル指数から除外する意向を示した。資金流出を招く大きな打撃となりそうだ。

インドネシア株は１月にＭＳＣＩが所有構造や取引データの不透明さを理由に「フロンティア市場」への格下げを警告して以来苦戦を強いられており、年初来３０％以上下落し、世界で最もパフォーマンスの悪い株式市場になっている。

ＭＳＣＩは、これらの問題に対処するための改革が十分な進展を見せていないとし、フロンティアへの格下げでさえ問題の深刻さを反映し得ないと指摘。インドネシアを「スタンドアローン」ステータスへの移行プロセスに組み入れた。

ウェブサイトに掲載した発表文で「市場の機能不全を巡っては依然として重大な懸念が残っている」と指摘。「したがって、ＭＳＣＩはインドネシアを引き続き新興国市場として分類することはもはや適切ではないと考えている」と述べた。

２０２７年４月までスタンドアローンへの格下げについて市場参加者と協議を行い、市場のガバナンスと機能の改善を示す明確な証拠が見られない限り、再分類を進める方針を示した。決定は同年６月までに公表される。

一方、インドネシア証券取引所は１６日、同国の資本市場の透明性と健全性を高めるための具体的な措置を講じたと発表。ＭＳＣＩの独立性を尊重しているとしつつ、今回の判断の根拠についてさらなる説明を求める考えを示した。

ＭＳＣＩによると、市場へのアクセス性や規模、流動性が著しく悪化した場合、スタンドアローンへの再分類が行われる可能性があり、直近の事例としてはアルゼンチンが挙げられる。

item.title: MSCI freezes certain Turkey index changes, warns of potential market downgrade
item.description: MSCI on Thursday froze certain changes to its Turkey equity indexes, saying it needed more time to assess market reforms and warning of a potential downgrade if sufficient progress was not made by mid-2027.
item.dc:creator: Mrinmay Dey, Rodrigo Campos
item.content:encoded: MSCI (MSCI.N) on Thursday froze certain changes to its Turkey equity indexes, saying it needed more time to assess market reforms and warning of a potential downgrade if sufficient progress was not made by mid-2027. Turkey's equity market has [USN:L8N45A0T5 TEXT:"faced investor scrutiny"] over free-float calculations and suspected coordinated trading in some stocks. MSCI's decision leaves Turkey's emerging-market status unchanged, but a future downgrade to frontier-market status could trigger selling by funds that track the MSCI Emerging Markets Index. The freeze took effect immediately and will remain in place until further notice, affecting changes stemming from index reviews and corporate events involving Turkish securities. MSCI said the decision followed concerns raised during its 2026 Market Classification Review over "possible coordinated trading through fund holdings closely affiliated with certain smaller listed companies." Such activity could undermine the reliability of free-float estimates and broader market integrity, the index provider said. "Institutional investors will need to see credible and sustained enforcement against coordinated trading, and disclosure standards that enable independent verification of the free float of Turkish securities," MSCI said. Turkey has a relatively small pool of stocks that meet the size and liquidity requirements of global institutional investors, concentrating capital in a handful of names and increasing scrutiny of free-float calculations and trading activity. The benchmark BIST 100 (.XU100) is on track for a fifth straight weekly decline and is down more than 20% from its record closing high in May. Under the freeze, MSCI will not increase foreign inclusion factors or the number of shares used in its indexes, add securities to the MSCI Turkey Investable Market Index, or make upward migrations across size-segment indexes. MSCI said that if sufficient progress was not evident by June 2027, it could take further steps, including consulting on a potential downgrade of Turkey from emerging-market to frontier- or standalone-market status. It will continue seeking feedback from market participants and monitoring the effectiveness of regulatory and enforcement measures. S&P Dow Jones Indices (SPGI.N) also warned in July that Turkey [USN:FWN4390QT TEXT:"risked a downgrade"] to frontier-market status from emerging-market status over market transparency and other concerns.

item.title: 日本政府、中国産の二酸化チタン顔料などの反ダンピング調査開始
item.description:
Kentaro Okasaka
[東京 １６日 ロイター] - 経済産業省と財務省は１６日、中国産の二酸化チタンルチ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
日本政府、中国産の二酸化チタン顔料などの反ダンピング調査開始 10:52 配信

中国広東省深セン市の港に積まれたコンテナ。2025年10月30日撮影。REUTERS/Tingshu Wang

Kentaro Okasaka

[東京 １６日 ロイター] - 経済産業省と財務省は１６日、中国産の二酸化チタンルチル型を基にした顔料や調製品の輸入について、不当廉売（ダンピング）関税の要否に関する合同調査を開始すると発表した。原則１年以内に終了する。

両省によると、対象品は一般的に白色の微細粉末で、自動車用や高級建築用の塗料などに使用される。

日本酸化チタン工業会から８月、課税申請が財務相に提出され、関係法令に基づき検討を行い、調査を行う必要があると認められた。工業会によると、中国からの輸入価格と正常価格を比較した不当廉売差額率は５０－６０％。国内販売価格を著しく下回り、国内では中国産品を引き合いに値下げを要求されたり、製造コスト増に応じた値上げを断念せざるを得なくなったりしたとしている。

item.title: Trump diz que está conversando com Rússia e China sobre desnuclearização
item.description: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, afirmou nesta quinta-feira que Washington mantém negociações com Moscou e Pequim com o objetivo de desnuclearizar os países com os maiores arsenais de armas nucleares.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, afirmou nesta quinta-feira que Washington mantém negociações com Moscou e Pequim com o objetivo de desnuclearizar os países com os maiores arsenais de armas nucleares. A Rússia possui o maior número de ogivas nucleares armazenadas, seguida pelos Estados Unidos e pela China, de acordo com o Instituto Internacional de Pesquisa para a Paz de Estocolmo. Os EUA superam a Rússia no número de ogivas implantadas. Durante uma entrevista à Newsmax, Trump disse esperar que a China “alcance” os EUA nos próximos cinco anos. “Tudo isso é uma pena, porque eu adoraria promover a desnuclearização, se possível, mas, na verdade, estamos conversando com a Rússia sobre isso e também com a China sobre a desnuclearização”, disse Trump ao veículo. A Newsmax informou que Trump havia conversado com o presidente chinês Xi Jinping sobre a desnuclearização. Os comentários de Trump ocorrem meses após o vencimento do Tratado de Redução de Armas Estratégicas, no início deste ano. O novo Tratado Start, assinado em 2010, permitia uma única prorrogação, que foi acordada pelo ex-presidente Joe Biden e pelo presidente russo Vladimir Putin por cinco anos. Qualquer nova prorrogação exige uma decisão executiva para estender voluntariamente os limites do tratado.

item.title: 中国関連疑いのハッカー、米社ツールの脆弱性悪用も グーグルが警告
item.description:
[１５日 ロイター] - 米グーグルは１５日、米サイバーセキュリティー企業ビヨンドトラストの遠隔サポート用機器に新たな脆弱性が見つかったことを受け、企業などに対し「広範な悪用の可能性」に備えるよう警告した。
グーグルの脅威分析部門グーグル・スレット・インテリジェンス・グループ（ＧＴＩＧ）とマンディアントによると、攻撃者はこの脆弱性の悪用に成功すれば、認証情報へのアクセス、任意のファイルのアップロード、ホストの制御掌握が可能になる。
詳細は以下の通り：
• グーグルのブログ投稿によると、中国との関連が疑われるハッカー集団「アーモリー・キャッスル」は８月、当時はまだ知られていなかったこの脆弱性を悪用した。
• この脆弱性は、情報技術（ＩＴ）チームがコンピューターなどの機器に遠隔アクセスしてトラブルシューティングを行う企業向けツール「ビヨンドトラスト・リモート・サポート」に影響を及ぼす。
•
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１５日 ロイター] - 米グーグルは１５日、米サイバーセキュリティー企業ビヨンドトラストの遠隔サポート用機器に新たな脆弱性が見つかったことを受け、企業などに対し「広範な悪用の可能性」に備えるよう警告した。

グーグルの脅威分析部門グーグル・スレット・インテリジェンス・グループ（ＧＴＩＧ）とマンディアントによると、攻撃者はこの脆弱性の悪用に成功すれば、認証情報へのアクセス、任意のファイルのアップロード、ホストの制御掌握が可能になる。

詳細は以下の通り：

• グーグルのブログ投稿によると、中国との関連が疑われるハッカー集団「アーモリー・キャッスル」は８月、当時はまだ知られていなかったこの脆弱性を悪用した。

• この脆弱性は、情報技術（ＩＴ）チームがコンピューターなどの機器に遠隔アクセスしてトラブルシューティングを行う企業向けツール「ビヨンドトラスト・リモート・サポート」に影響を及ぼす。

• グーグルは、脆弱性が公表されたことで、アーモリー・キャッスルなどが過去の行動と同様に広範な悪用を試みる可能性があると指摘。修正プログラムの適用またはリスク軽減措置を速やかに実施するよう呼びかけた。

item.title: Lula defends cutting Brazil's criminal responsibility age to 16 for heinous crimes
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva said on Thursday he supports lowering the minimum age of criminal responsibility in Brazil to 16 from 18 years for heinous crimes in an interview with TV Globo's Jornal Nacional, the country's main newscast.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva said on Thursday he supports lowering the minimum age of criminal responsibility in Brazil to 16 from 18 years for heinous crimes in an interview with TV Globo's Jornal Nacional, the country's main newscast. Lula will face Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, in an election runoff on Oct. 25, after the senator [USN:L6N45Q04L TEXT:"surprisingly led"] him in the first round Opposition lawmakers have proposed including a reduction in the minimum age of criminal responsibility in a government-backed bill aimed at strengthening the powers of the federal government in public safety The bill was set to be voted on Thursday in the Senate, but the vote was postponed amid the debate over whether to include changes in the criminal responsibility age Lula said that reducing the age of criminal responsibility should not be discussed in that bill, arguing that the proposal before Congress focuses on a different issue Opposition lawmakers, including Bolsonaro, supported lowering the minimum age of criminal responsibility to 16 years in general, and to 14 for violent crimes

item.title: Jenna Ortega plays an artificial friend in need in 'Klara and the Sun'
item.description: In Taika Waititi's "Klara and the Sun", which stars Jenna Ortega and Amy Adams, a robot delivers lessons on humanity.
item.dc:creator: Hanna Rantala
item.content:encoded: In Taika Waititi's "Klara and the Sun", which stars Jenna Ortega and Amy Adams, a robot delivers lessons on humanity. The dystopian drama is based on Nobel Prize-winning author Kazuo Ishiguro's 2021 bestseller of the same name and set in a technologically advanced future, following what one character describes as a third world war triggered by the abuse of the internet. Ortega plays Klara, an outdated model of an Artificial Friend, an android companion whose sell-by date is fast approaching when, to her relief, teenager Josie (Mia Tharia) and her mother (Adams) buy her. Programmed to prevent loneliness, Klara is full of quirks and hopes and believes in the healing power of the sun. Her traits come in handy in a household marked by grief and mystery. "It felt like a very timely story," said Ortega at the movie's world premiere at the London Film Festival on Thursday. "To see it put in a futuristic world and see that we still struggle with the same things and the answer's kind of always in one another and listening to one another, I thought it was a really nuanced, thoughtful way of putting it." Waititi, who directed, co-wrote and produced the movie, was struck by Ishiguro's allegorical interplay between humans, artificial intelligence and nature. "She's a machine who comes into the world of a broken family and somehow teaches them the importance of being human," Waititi said. "It's vital right now because we're now in a moment where we're maybe on the cusp of losing control of our relationship with technology," said Waititi, adding that he also wanted the film to "remind people to put the devices down, not because there's a threat or anything, but just put the thing down because it's a distraction, and just be with the people you're with." While Waititi injected some of his signature humour into the movie, he said he wanted to "keep the profound feeling and the drama from the book". "There's some funny bits there, but it's probably my most dramatic film," Waititi said. "Klara and the Sun", which also stars Natasha Lyonne, Steve Buscemi, Aran Murphy and Rachel House, will go on release globally from October 21.

item.title: 原油先物は小幅安、米の「影の船団」制裁緩和の可能性見極め
item.description:
Sam Li Lewis Jackson
[北京 １６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Sam Li　Lewis Jackson

[北京 １６日 ロイター] - アジア時間の原油先物は小幅に下落。投資家は中東情勢を巡るリスクと、「影の船団」に対する米国の制裁緩和の可能性を見極めようとしている。

００１２ＧＭＴ（日本時間午前９時１２分）時点で、北海ブレント先物は０．４１ドル（０．３９％）安の１バレル＝１０５．５１ドル、米ＷＴＩ先物は０．５４ドル（０．５５％）安の９７．４３ドル。

１５日の清算値は、米原油在庫の大幅な減少が支援材料となり、ＷＴＩが３％超上昇した一方、北海ブレントはほぼ横ばいだった。

国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）は１５日、供給を増やして価格高騰を抑えるため、ディーゼル燃料（軽油）２０００万バレル超と、３月に約束した過去最大規模の緊急備蓄放出の未実施分を市場に供給することで合意した。

海通期貨は１６日のリポートで、前日の取引で原油価格が上昇したことについて「投資家がこうした措置に不満を抱いていることを示している」と指摘。「原油市場を本当に沈静化させるのは中東情勢の緊張緩和だ」との見方を示した。

米当局者が１４日に明らかにしたところによると、トランプ政権は過去最高水準にある世界の海上輸送運賃を引き下げるため、ロシアやイラン、ベネズエラなどの原油や石油製品を輸送してきた、いわゆる「影の船団」の一部船舶に対する制裁解除を検討している。

一方、サウジアラビアとイエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派の戦闘激化や、同地域での船舶に対する攻撃の再開が原油価格を下支えしている。

item.title: Ｆ１＝ハース、新ドライバーのカマラと契約 オコンの後任
item.description: ［１５日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１５日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１のハースは１５日、２０２７年シーズンから起用するブラジル人ドライバーのラファエル・カマラ（２１）と複数年契約を締結したと発表した。

ハースは先月３０日にフランス人ドライバーのエステバン・オコンが今シーズン限りで退団することを発表していた。

後任となるカマラは、２５年にトライデントでＦ３のタイトルを獲得。今シーズンはインビクタ・レーシングからＦ２に参戦しており、ルーキーながらドライバーズランキングで２位に７ポイント差をつけて首位に立っている。

ハースはリザーブドライバーの平川亮やジャック・ドゥーハン（オーストラリア）、現Ｆ２王者のレオナルド・フォルナローリ（イタリア）らを対象にテストを実施。しかし、８月に行われたプライベートテストを経て、カマラが最有力候補となっていた。

ハースの代表を務める小松礼雄氏は声明で、「ポルトガルでのテストプログラムで、彼はマシンに慣れるための十分な時間がない中でも非常にうまく対応できることを証明し、単なるスピード以上のものを見せた。彼は自分自身のポテンシャルを最大限引き出せる環境づくりに優れており、とても印象的だった」と述べた。

item.title: Australia names offshore site for Inpex-led Bonaparte carbon storage project
item.description: Australia on Friday designated the West Peron undersea rock formation, off the country's north coast, as a storage site for the 8 million metric ton-per-year Bonaparte carbon capture and storage project proposed by Japan's Inpex .
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Australia on Friday designated the West Peron undersea rock formation, off the country's north coast, as a storage site for the 8 million metric ton-per-year Bonaparte carbon capture and storage project proposed by Japan's Inpex (1605.T) . The Bonaparte project is initially expected to receive carbon dioxide from Inpex's Ichthys liquefied natural gas (LNG) project before eventually expanding storage services to multiple industrial facilities. Inpex proposes to permanently store up to 443 million tons of carbon dioxide deep underground in the West Peron formation over a period of up to 35 years. The formation is a layer of porous rock located deep beneath the seabed. Australia Resources Minister Madeleine King said the decision demonstrated the government's support for technologies aimed at reducing emissions from industries where cutting greenhouse gas emissions remains difficult. "Carbon capture and storage will play an important role in reducing emissions from hard-to-abate industries, supporting Australia's transition to net zero," King said. Australia has a legislated target to reach net zero emissions by 2050.

item.title: サッカー＝ＦＩＦＡ会長が謝罪も「あくまで提案だった」、欧州勢の反発やまず
item.description: ［チューリヒ １５日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［チューリヒ　１５日　ロイター］ - 国際サッカー連盟（ＦＩＦＡ）のジャンニ・インファンティノ会長は１５日、ワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）運営などを担う子会社設立計画（ＦＦＥ）の撤回を巡る混乱についてＦＩＦＡ理事会で謝罪。しかし欧州各国からは反発の声も上がった。

インファンティノ会長は「ＦＦＥに関連するコミュニケーションや協議のプロセスにおいてミスを犯し、それが多くの結果を招いてしまったこと」について謝罪。ただし「重要なのはこれがあくまで提案であり、決して決定事項ではなかったという点だ」とも強調した。

同会長に対して厳しい批判を続ける欧州勢からは、ドイツ・サッカー連盟（ＤＦＢ）のベルント・ノイエンドルフ会長が、インファンティノ氏がトップに留まる限り、組織に必要なガバナンス改革は実現できないと主張。「完全にやり直す必要がある。政治的な再出発が必要だと考えている」と語った。

イングランド・サッカー協会（ＦＡ）のデビー・ヒューイット会長は、インファンティノ氏に評議会のメンバーから提起された疑問に答えるよう求め、もしそれがなされないのであれば、会長職にとどまる資格はないと厳しく批判。「それほど深く反省しているのなら、ぜひ私たちに（ＦＦＥ関連の）文書を共有していただきたい」と要求した。

一方、モーリタニア・イスラム共和国サッカー連盟（ＦＦＲＩＭ）のアフメド・ヤヒヤ会長は、各国協会への資金提供の増加やＷ杯の出場枠を４８チームに拡大したことなどをインファンティノ会長の実績として挙げて擁護。「私たち（アフリカ諸国）は、ジャンニこそが今後もサッカー界を率いていくのにふさわしい人物だと考えている。間違いなく、大多数がジャンニの続投を望んでいる」と述べた。

item.title: Euro gets much-needed reprieve as AI wobbles rock the dollar
item.description: The dollar headed for its first weekly fall in five weeks on Friday, lifting the euro from a 17-month low as wobbles in AI investment and drop in US yields put the brakes on recent gains.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The dollar headed for its first weekly fall in five weeks on Friday, lifting the euro from a 17-month low as wobbles in AI investment and drop in US yields put the brakes on recent gains. AI stocks have [USN:L6N460140 TEXT:"cratered"] this week and the [USN:L4N46112V TEXT:"stress spread"] to parts of the credit market as investors who have crowded in to bets all along the AI supply chain [USN:L4N46112V TEXT:"worry"] that data centre operators might not manage to be profitable in time to pay their debts. The result, so far, has been a flight to [USN:L4N46108S TEXT:"Treasuries"], where the US 10-year yield is set for its largest weekly fall in more than a year, and to sell a dollar which has been propelled, in part, thanks to the AI boom boosting the economy. Moves in the Asia morning were slight, leaving the dollar down 0.2% this week at 158.13 yen and shedding about 0.1% to $1.1210 per euro . The reversal has come not a moment too soon for the common currency, which over the previous five weeks had dropped more than 3% on the dollar on jitters about France's growing debt pile and a winter energy squeeze. With the market positioned long in dollars, more AI wobbles could unwind that and push the dollar down further. "The reaction function of the dollar to a serious repricing of the AI capex boom should be unambiguously dollar bearish," said Spectra Markets president Brent Donnelly. "If the market is pricing rising odds of peak AI capex, the USD is a sell. The entire US economy is a one-legged stool balanced on the AI trade." The dollar index , which measures the US currency against six major peers, was at 102.07, set for a 0.14% drop in the week. Sterling was steady at $1.3270 for a weekly rise of 0.3%, helped by data showing Britain's economy unexpectedly grew 0.1% in August. The New Zealand dollar looked likely to scratch out a weekly gain of 0.1% at $0.5621. The Australian dollar was flat at $0.6921 and an outlier in heading for a fall of 0.8% on the dollar this week, after a surprisingly soft jobs report on Thursday had markets paring back expectations for another rise in interest rates. Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh speaks in Bangkok on Friday at 0330 GMT (11:30 p.m. ET Thursday) at the International Monetary Fund's annual meeting, a final chance to shape market expectations for the Fed's decision in less than two weeks. "Given Warsh’s distaste for forward guidance, he might subtly signal his preference for the October rate outcome," said Carol Kong, currency strategist at Commonwealth Bank of Australia. "Any hints from Warsh can influence the October Fed pricing and the USD sharply today." Traders are pricing in a 72% chance of the Fed standing pat later this month, up from 53% a month earlier, the CME FedWatch tool showed. The expected likelihood of a hike rose sharply after a hotter-than-expected CPI report this week, but bets eased after Fed officials said the central bank could wait for more clarity before the meeting.

item.title: Amancio Ortega, dueño de Zara, compra una emblemática torre en Chicago por US$550 millones
item.description: La oficina familiar del fundador de Inditex adquirió el edificio One North Wacker, de 51 plantas, que alberga oficinas de empresas como PwC, UBS y Fitch Ratings.
item.dc:creator: Clara Hernanz Lizarraga
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Amancio Ortega, propietario de Inditex SA, pagó unos US$550 millones por una emblemática torre de Chicago, una de las mayores operaciones inmobiliarias de oficinas de este año en Estados Unidos, en el marco de la continua expansión de su cartera global de inmuebles de prestigio. Su oficina familiar, Pontegadea Inversiones SL, adquirió el edificio One North Wacker, de 51 plantas, situado en el distrito financiero de la ciudad, según informó un portavoz a Bloomberg después de que CoStar diera a conocer dicha operación. Las oficinas están alquiladas a empresas como PwC, UBS Group AG ( UBS ) y Fitch Ratings. Esta operación se suma a la creciente presencia de Ortega en Chicago, donde Pontegadea ya es propietaria de una torre residencial de 492 viviendas adquirida en 2023, del antiguo edificio del Esquire Theater, de un hotel y de otros inmuebles. Ver más: Detrás del discreto estilo de vida de Sandra Ortega, hija del dueño de Zara, hay una fortuna que crece El fundador de Inditex, la decimoquinta persona más rica del mundo, ha construido una de las mayores carteras inmobiliarias privadas de Europa, que abarca hoteles, almacenes logísticos, bloques de viviendas y centros comerciales en todo el mundo. Ortega lleva años canalizando los miles de millones de euros que recibe en concepto de dividendos de Inditex hacia inversiones a través de Pontegadea, lo que proporciona a su family office una reserva de capital inusualmente grande y estable para invertir. Se prevé que reciba la cifra récord de EUR$3.200 millones (US$3.600 millones) de la empresa de moda solo en 2026. Ver más: El fundador de Zara lidera el avance de los ultrarricos en el inmobiliario de US$1 billón A inicios de este año, Pontegadea adquirió el complejo de oficinas Capital 8 de París por unos EUR$850 millones (US$952,5 millones), su mayor operación inmobiliaria en Europa y la mayor transacción de oficinas en Europa continental desde 2022. Su cartera, valorada en más de EUR$19.000 millones en 2024, va más allá del sector inmobiliario. En 2025 acordó la compra de una participación del 49% en el operador portuario británico PD Ports y, posteriormente, se unió a un consorcio liderado por Macquarie Asset Management para adquirir el grupo logístico australiano Qube Holdings Ltd. en una operación valorada en unos 11.700 millones de dólares australianos (US$8.100 millones). Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: 北朝鮮ミサイル総局トップ、韓国の極超音速滑空体試射に疑義
item.description: [ソウル １５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ソウル １５日 ロイター] - 北朝鮮ミサイル総局の張昌河局長は、韓国がこのほど試験発射した極超音速滑空体（ＨＧＶ）について、主張されているような極超音速飛行を達成していない可能性があると述べた。朝鮮中央通信（ＫＣＮＡ）が１５日伝えた。

張氏は、韓国が１０月８日の試験発射後に公開した写真には、極超音速飛行に伴う痕跡が見られないと指摘。

「外観は非常にきれいで、塗装もそのまま残り、すすによる汚れも全くない。極めて高い温度を特徴とする極超音速飛行の状況を経たとは信じがたい」と述べた。

これに対し、韓国国防省は声明で、ミサイルには耐熱素材を使用しており、そのためすすが付着していないと説明。

「わが軍は今後、将来の安全保障にとって重要な戦略資産であるＨＧＶの兵器化に向け、関連技術をさらに発展させていく計画だ」とした。

item.title: サッカー＝南野が復帰戦で2得点に絡む活躍、モナコ勝利 ＥＣＬ
item.description: ［１５日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１５日　ロイター］ - サッカーの欧州カンファレンスリーグ（ＥＣＬ）は１５日、各地で１次リーグの試合を行い、南野拓実が約１０カ月ぶりの復帰を果たしたモナコ（フランス）がＣＳＫＡソフィア（ブルガリア）に２─１で勝利した。

昨年１２月に前十字靱帯を断裂した南野はスタメンで今季初の公式戦出場。２得点の起点となるパスを出すなど存在感を発揮した。

ドイツ１部ブンデスリーガで首位に立つフライブルクはヤブロネツ（チェコ）に３─２で競り勝った。鈴木唯人はフル出場、後藤啓介は後半２６分から出場して勝利に貢献した。山本理仁はベンチ入りするも出番がなかった。

日本人８人がベンチ入りしたシントトロイデン（ベルギー）はイベリア・トビリシ（ジョージア）に２─０で勝利。小久保玲央ブライアン、谷口彰悟、石渡ネルソンがフル出場し、松澤海斗と新川志音が後半途中から出場した。

三笘薫が故障離脱中のブライトン（イングランド）は、辛島侑烈がフル出場したカウノ・ジャルギリス（リトアニア）に４─０で圧勝。鈴木淳之介がフル出場したコペンハーゲン（デンマーク）はブラガ（ポルトガル）を３─０で下した。中山雄太がフル出場したレッドスター（セルビア）はルガーノ（スイス）に２─３で敗れた。

item.title: 米アマゾン、新しいＡＩ端末2機種発表 情報を聞き取り・記録
item.description:
Greg Bensinger
[サンフランシスコ １５日 ロイター] - 米アマゾンは１５日、昨年買収した「Ｂｅｅ」ブ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米アマゾン、新しいＡＩ端末2機種発表　情報を聞き取り・記録 10:16 配信

アマゾンのロゴ。2025年2月11日撮影のイメージ写真。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

Greg Bensinger

[サンフランシスコ １５日 ロイター] - 米アマゾンは１５日、昨年買収した「Ｂｅｅ」ブランドの下、１日を通して人々の情報を聞き取り・記録し、カレンダーのリマインダー機能やＡＩ（人工知能）を活用した分析結果を提供する２つの新デバイスを発表した。

「フロンティア」はブレスレット型で価格は７５ドル、「エクリプス」はマグネット式ポータブル充電器に似た形のデバイスで価格は１００ドル。エクリプスはスマートフォンに取り付けるタイプとなる。

サンフランシスコで開催された「TechCrunch Disrupt」カンファレンスで、アマゾンのデバイス担当責任者パノス・パネイ氏は「これらのデバイスはあなたの１日全体を『聞き取る』」と説明。「あなたが交わした会話を思い出させたり、やることリストを思い出させたり、他の人への約束があることを教えてくれたりする」と語った。

同社によると、ユーザーは電源を入れるタイミングを自分で決めることでプライバシーを管理でき、必要に応じて分析結果や過去の会話を削除することも可能。アマゾンは音声を保存しない。

データは１４日間保持されるが、ユーザーは月額１２ドルのサブスクリプションを支払うことで、その期間を延長できる。また、これらのデバイスはアマゾンのサブスクリプション型生成ＡＩ音声サービス「アレクサ＋（プラス）」にも接続可能だ。
