"The spear would have gone through the skin and major muscles, especially the pectoralis, as well as the ribcage and muscles between the ribs, and the lung," said biological anthropologist Emma Pomeroy of the University of Cambridge in England, lead author of the study published on Thursday in the journal Scientific Reports. "The location could be like the kind of 'heart shot' hunters use to kill animals quickly by puncturing the heart, but that is a bit speculative. We do see heart shots as a hunting strategy both today and in the archaeological record. Neanderthals would have known this would lead to a quick death," Pomeroy said. University of Cambridge archaeologist and study co-author Graeme Barker, who has led Shanidar Cave excavations since 2015, said the likeliest scenario is interpersonal violence. The researchers said the violence probably occurred either between members of a particular Neanderthal group or between members of rival Neanderthal groups, calling a Homo sapiens attack or an accidental injury less likely. The researchers found shards of bone displaced by the weapon. The injury indicated that the spear entered from above with a downward trajectory, penetrating the left chest cavity from the front and traveling through the body before punching the hole in the scapula, causing quick death. ANOTHER INJURY In addition to the scapula, the researchers found some ribs, a nearly complete right hand and seven teeth, mostly from the front of the lower jaw, belonging to Shanidar A. The teeth bore evidence that this Neanderthal had survived brutal injury at least a year before death — a blow to the face resulting in front teeth being smashed and lost. One tooth was split, with half remaining rotated in the mouth and others pushed out of position. "The pain would have been extreme, and basic needs like eating and drinking would have been difficult, perhaps meaning Shanidar A needed food mashing and being able to rest. It's likely that Shanidar A did need some care from members of the group for some basic needs during recovery," Pomeroy said. Shanidar A was one of five Neanderthals, four adults and one infant, whose bodies were carefully tucked behind a rock pillar in the cave in a burial cluster within a generation or so of each other. The cave was occupied by Neanderthals for tens of thousands of years as a seasonal campsite, and later by Homo sapiens. Neanderthals were more robustly built than Homo sapiens, with larger brows. They lived as hunter-gatherers and inhabited Eurasia from the Atlantic coast to the Ural Mountains from about 400,000 years ago until a bit after 40,000 years ago, disappearing after Homo sapiens became established in the region. The two species interbred, with modern non-African human populations bearing residual Neanderthal DNA. The cave, overlooking the Great Zab river valley, has been a source of information about Neanderthals since the 1950s, with Shanidar A now offering new insight into their behavior. "We see evidence of two contrasting facets of human nature – care and violence – juxtaposed in the same individual," Pomeroy said. "We see evidence all around us today that violence and care are both aspects of how we humans behave, and we see this here in Shanidar A, too. Neanderthals were like us in many respects, both the good and the bad, and this find really highlights that, going against stereotypes of Neanderthals as unintelligent, uncaring cavemen and cavewomen," Pomeroy said.

Source: Reuters

FAST

WASHINGTON: US President Donald Trump scrapped plans to livestream the execution of the former Army major who killed 13 people at Fort Hood, overruling Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth on Thursday (Oct 15) after the proposal drew opposition from Republicans, religious leaders and the public. The reversal ended a plan to broadcast Nidal Hasan’s Dec 3 firing-squad execution. It also marked a rare public disagreement between Trump and one of the president’s closest allies, although the Pentagon said the two were “completely aligned.” Hegseth had announced plans to livestream the execution at the Fort Hood military base in Texas, the site of Hasan's 2009 attack. No other country is known to televise or livestream judicial executions. Trump and his advisers had been unaware of the livestream plan, said a White House official speaking on condition of anonymity.

"I think streaming the execution for all to see might have been a strong deterrent for the World to witness how America deals with Terrorists and SCUM like Hasan but, many very good and well meaning people would rather not watch him die, through streaming, or through any other visual device," Trump wrote in a social media post. "He will die, as scheduled, by firing squad, but this event will not be streamed." The families of Hasan's victims will be able to view the execution in person if they so choose, as is standard at US executions. Some of Trump 's fellow Republicans, including Vice President JD Vance, as well as religious leaders had expressed everything from doubts to outright condemnation of the Pentagon's livestream plan. Opinion polls showed a majority of Americans opposed livestreaming it. Archbishop Timothy Broglio, who oversees the spiritual care of Catholic members of the US armed forces, also raised objections, while Pope Leo condemned capital punishment in all its forms. An attorney representing Hasan could not immediately be reached for comment, and it was unclear if the scheduled Dec 3 execution date would be delayed by legal challenges.

A SPLIT WITH HEGSETH It was Trump 's first major public split with Hegseth, a Trump ally. But it was unclear whether the split would politically imperil Hegseth given their strong ties. In a statement, the Pentagon said Trump spoke with Hegseth about the decision before announcing it on Truth Social. "The Secretary supports the President's decision, and they are completely aligned," chief Pentagon spokesman Sean Parnell said in a statement. Capital punishment in the US already was facing renewed scrutiny after Christa Pike, convicted of murder in the 1990s, survived two lethal injections in a failed execution attempt by Tennessee last month that left her badly injured and requiring hospitalisation.

Related:

US military to livestream firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter

Outrage over US military plan to livestream firing squad execution

US House Speaker says execution livestream could be terrorist 'recruiting tool'

"SERIOUS CONSEQUENCES" A military jury convicted Hasan, a former US Army psychiatrist, of premeditated murder for fatally shooting 13 unarmed soldiers and wounding 32 others in a medical facility at the vast base. Law enforcement shot Hasan during his rampage, paralyzing him from the waist down, and he now uses a wheelchair. Hegseth had said the broadcasting of the execution was needed to ensure that people understand that "there's serious consequences for these types of things." Midterm elections on Nov 3 will determine whether Republicans retain control of Congress as voters increasingly register disapproval of Trump 's policies in opinion polls. Senator John Curtis, a Republican representing Utah, called the cancellation "the right move" in a statement. US Representative Richard Neal, a Democrat from Massachusetts, called the original plan "a profound failure of moral judgment and basic human decency."

Source: Reuters/co/fs

item.title: 米国株式市場・午前＝ナスダック1カ月ぶり安値圏、ＡＩ株売り加速
item.description: ［ニューヨーク １５日 ロイター］ - １５日午前の米株式市場は、ナスダック総合が約１カ月ぶりの安値圏に下落した。金利...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場・午前＝ナスダック1カ月ぶり安値圏、ＡＩ株売り加速 10/15 23:43 配信

2026年9月15日、ニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE） REUTERS/Jeenah Moon/File Photo

［ニューヨーク　１５日　ロイター］ - １５日午前の米株式市場は、ナスダック総合が約１カ月ぶりの安値圏に下落した。金利上昇が人工知能（ＡＩ）投資に影響するとの懸念からＡＩ関連株の売りが加速したほか、経済指標が米国の物価上昇圧力の強まりを示したことも重しとなった。

半導体メーカーの台湾積体電路製造（ＴＳＭＣ）が、マクロ経済の不確実性を理由に２０２７年の見通しについて慎重な姿勢を示したことも、投資家心理を圧迫した。

多額の債務を抱えるデータセンター運営会社コアウィーブは、最近のハイテク株急落の中心にあり、前日の１５％安に続いて８．５％下落。クラウド大手オラクルも、前日の約９％安に続き小幅安となった。

半導体株も下落し、エヌビディアは３．３％安、マイクロン・テクノロジーは５％安、アドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイシズ（ＡＭＤ）は６．４％安となった。

サクソのチーフ投資ストラテジスト、チャル・チャナナ氏は「投資家は、将来の成長が株価評価にどこまで織り込まれているのか、事業拡大の資金をどう調達しているのか、そして投資がいつ十分な収益を生むのかについて、疑問を強めている。コアウィーブの社債価格の調整は、ＡＩインフラの拡大にどんな条件でも資金を提供しようとする投資家の姿勢が弱まっていることを示唆している」とした。

「恐怖指数」として知られるＣＢＯＥボラティリティー指数（ＶＩＸ）は２週間ぶりの高水準を付け、０．８３ポイント高の１７．７４となった。

item.title: Yemen's Houthis hit palace in Aden, coalition details attacks on Saudi infrastructure
item.description: Yemen's Houthis fired missiles at the presidential palace complex in the southern city of Aden on Thursday, killing five people, the government said, as the Saudi-led coalition listed dozens of Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure in recent weeks.
item.dc:creator: Enas Alashray, Mohammed Ghobari, Eman Abouhassira
item.content:encoded: Yemen's Houthis fired missiles at the presidential palace complex in the southern city of Aden on Thursday, killing five people, the government said, as the Saudi-led coalition listed dozens of Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure in recent weeks. The attack was the first in the current conflict between the Iran-aligned Houthis and Saudi Arabia on Aden's Al-Maashiq palace, the seat of Yemen's Saudi-backed and internationally recognised government. The conflict is a new theatre in the wider regional war that began with US and Israeli strikes on Iran in February. Yemen's prime minister and cabinet members were safe following the attack, Yemeni Information Minister Moammar al-Eryani said. Witnesses told Reuters they heard loud booms near the palace. Yemen's cabinet said the attack involved missiles and drones. Yemen's health minister Qasim Buhaibeh said five people were killed and 16 wounded in what he described as a Houthi attack on the government's official headquarters at the presidential complex. The casualties included guards and civilian employees. Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree said its fighters had bombed what he described as the Saudi military operations headquarters in Aden, as part of the group's declared policy of targeting "Saudi reinforcements wherever they were located". The Houthi-run news agency SABA said the headquarters was run by Saudi officers and that there were weapons depots there. Reuters could not independently verify the claims. Fighting between the Houthis and Saudi-backed forces resumed last month, and aid agencies [USN:L6N4600ML TEXT:"have warned"] of rapidly worsening conditions in Yemen. Last week, government forces launched a campaign to recapture areas controlled by the Houthis, recovering ground near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a key shipping artery. War broke out in Yemen in 2014 when [USN:L1N45Q02Z TEXT:"the Houthis"] seized the capital Sanaa, driving the government south. A Saudi-led military intervention the following year led to a bloody stalemate before a 2022 truce that held until this year. In that phase of the conflict Houthi fighters and allied forces briefly seized Al-Maashiq palace during a battle for Aden, before withdrawing. COALITION SAYS HOUTHIS ARE GETTING MISSILES, FAST BOATS As Saudi Arabia backs government forces, the Houthis [USN:L1N4610L5 TEXT:"have been firing"] ballistic missiles and drones at Saudi airports, ports and oil installations, turning US ally Saudi Arabia into a [USN:L1N46108L TEXT:"pressure point"] in the wider war [USN:L6N45Y0GN TEXT:"and threatening"] its ambitious economic plans. On Thursday, the Saudi-led military coalition said the Houthis had attempted to attack dozens of such sites, highlighting the risk to Saudi civilian infrastructure. The governing council of the UN's International Civil Aviation Organization condemned the recent attacks on civilian airports, aircraft, and aviation infrastructure in Saudi Arabia. Coalition spokesperson Turki al-Maliki told reporters that the Houthis had launched 20 attacks on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh this month, killing 17 people and wounding 333 others. The airport is one of Saudi Arabia's main international aviation hubs. The coalition said Houthi attacks on Abha airport in southwestern Saudi Arabia near the Yemeni border had killed three people and wounded 28. Maliki said the Houthis had acquired advanced military technology with the help of "regional actors," including ballistic missiles, drones and explosive-laden fast boats. Iran [USN:L1N43P0D6 TEXT:"has provided"] weapons, money and training to the Houthis, although Tehran has officially denied arming them in violation of a UN arms embargo. Maliki also said the coalition had destroyed 127 weapons storage facilities and launch platforms in Yemen's mountainous areas, calling on the Houthis to immediately halt operations targeting civilians and civilian infrastructure. Shortly afterwards, the Houthi military spokesperson said Saudi airspace and airports were unsafe, renewing a warning to airlines while excluding airspace over the holy cities of Mecca and Medina. Saudi Arabia's civil defence authority issued early-warning alerts throughout Thursday over potential threats in the cities of Najran and Jizan, as well as the wider Najran and Jazan regions, before later saying the danger had passed. The Saudi-led coalition said on Thursday that it had intercepted and destroyed a drone in the southwestern Saudi Arabian city of Khamis Mushait, and another launched towards the country's southern region.

item.description: [ワシントン １５日 ロイター] - 米労働省が１５日発表した１０月１０日までの週の新規失業保険申請件数（季節調整...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米新規失業保険申請1000件増の19.9万件、一時解雇なお低水準 10/15 23:09 配信

就職フェアの会場に置かれた求人応募用紙。2021年5月、米ニューヨークで撮影。REUTERS/Brendan McDermid

[ワシントン　１５日　ロイター] - 米労働省が１５日発表した１０月１０日までの週の新規失業保険申請件数（季節調整済み）は前週比１０００件増の１９万９０００件となった。小幅な増加にとどまり、一時解雇（レイオフ）が低水準で推移する中、労働市場の安定は維持されている。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は２０万件だった。

１０月３日までの１週間の継続受給件数（季節調整済み）は４０００件減の１７１万件となった。ただ、継続受給件数には、大学を最近卒業した人や、職歴が浅い、または全くないために受給資格がない人は含まれていない。

item.title: ＷＥＦ、ラガルド氏を次期会長に指名か 11月2日にも＝関係筋
item.description:
Dave Graham Francesco Canepa
[チューリヒ／バンコク １５日 ロイター] - 世界経済フォ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＷＥＦ、ラガルド氏を次期会長に指名か　11月2日にも＝関係筋 10/15 23:05 配信

2026年10月14日撮影　REUTERS/Athit Perawongmeth

Dave Graham　Francesco Canepa

[チューリヒ／バンコク １５日 ロイター] - 世界経済フォーラム（ＷＥＦ）が来月にも欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のラガルド総裁を次期会長に指名する可能性があることが分かった。同組織の関係筋４人がロイターに明らかにした。実現すればラガルド氏はＥＣＢ総裁を任期前に退任することになり、ＥＣＢ首脳部の広範な人事刷新につながる。

関係筋によると、ＷＥＦの理事会は１１月２日に開催され、ラガルド氏自身も参加する。この会合でラガルド氏を次期会長に選出する可能性がある。ただ、最終決定にはまだ至っていないという。

また、理事会は代わりに、来年１月のダボス年次総会でラガルド氏の次期会長選出のための投票日を設定することもあり得るという。

ラガルド氏のＥＣＢ総裁任期は２０２７年１０月まで。早期退任となれば、ＥＣＢの他２つの要職を含む人事を巡る複雑な政治的駆け引きが始まる見通し。

関係筋は、ラガルド氏の選出は確実ではないとしながらも、ラガルド氏は理事会で幅広い支持を得ていると述べた。

ＥＣＢはコメントを差し控えた。

ラガルド氏は、来年までＥＣＢにとどまると述べてきたが、１０月の任期満了まで正式に職務を続けると明言するには至っていない。

item.title: アンソロピックに上場延期要請、ＮＹ市会計監査官
item.description: [１５日 ロイター] - ニューヨーク市のマーク・レビン会計監査官が、人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックに米国で...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アンソロピックに上場延期要請、ＮＹ市会計監査官 10/15 23:03 配信

2024年5月20日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo

[１５日 ロイター] - ニューヨーク市のマーク・レビン会計監査官が、人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックに米国での新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）を延期すべきとの考えを伝えたことが分かった。安全性や企業統治、開発ペースに関する懸念に対処することが必要だとした。ロイターが１５日、同社のダリオ・アモデイ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）に宛てた書簡を入手した。

ＡＩを巡っては、安全性やサイバーセキュリティー上の脅威、悪用など、潜在的なリスクへの監視が強まっている。

書簡でレビン氏は「同社はＩＰＯに向けて突き進むのではなく、こうした前例のないリスクへの対処に力を注ぐべきだ」と記している。

市会計監査官室によると、市の公的年金基金はプライベートエクイティ（ＰＥ）投資を通じ、アンソロピックに合計７００万ドルの投資エクスポージャーを持つ。

ニューヨーク市の会計監査官は市の財政を監督し、年金基金を管理するとともに、公的支出や財務慣行を監視する役割を担う。基金の資産総額は３２５０億ドルを超える。

item.title: 米9月ＰＰＩ、前年比6.3％上昇 22年12月以来の大きな伸び
item.description: [ワシントン １５日 ロイター] - 米労働省が１５日発表した９月の卸売物価指数（ＰＰＩ、最終需要向け財・サービス）は前...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米9月ＰＰＩ、前年比6.3％上昇　22年12月以来の大きな伸び 10/15 22:52 配信

米ペンシルベニア州フィラデルフィアのガソリンスタンド。5月撮影。REUTERS/Seth Herald

[ワシントン １５日 ロイター] - 米労働省が１５日発表した９月の卸売物価指数（ＰＰＩ、最終需要向け財・サービス）は前年比６．３％上昇し、２０２２年１２月以来の大幅な伸びとなった。前月比では１．３％上昇し、２２年３月以来、４年半ぶりの大きな伸びを記録した。財（モノ）・サービスの両面でコスト上昇が進んでおり、エネルギー関連以外にもインフレが広がっていることが改めて示された。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は前月比０．５％上昇だった。８月は当初の０．４％上昇から０．５％上昇に上方改定された。

前日には消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）で幅広い品目が上昇したことが示されており、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が月内の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で利上げに踏み切る可能性が改めて意識された。

オックスフォード・エコノミクスの米国担当シニアエコノミスト、マシュー・マーティン氏は「インフレの定着と底堅い労働市場を踏まえ、ＦＲＢは市場の予想より早く動く必要があると確信しているため、月内のＦＯＭＣで利上げに踏み切ると予想する」と述べた。

フィフス・サード・ウェルス・アドバイザーズの最高投資責任者（ＣＩＯ）、クリス・オズモンド氏は、経済指標でインフレ加速、消費者支出の鈍化、労働市場の停滞が示されたことに言及し、「厳しい経済環境が交錯していることが改めて明らかになった」と指摘。「ＦＲＢにとってますます困難な組み合わせになっている。政策金利の据え置きを正当化することはできるが、インフレが鈍化しなければ、様子見姿勢をとるコストは高まる」と述べた。

＜モノ価格、エネルギー主導で急伸＞

９月のモノの価格は２．６％上昇し、政府が０９年１２月に同統計の集計を開始して以来の大きな伸びとなった。エネルギー価格が１０．８％上昇し、幅広いモノの価格の上昇分の８０％以上を占めた。

ガソリン価格は２０．３％上昇したほか、ディーゼル燃料（軽油）、ジェット燃料、家庭用電力の価格も上昇した。食品価格は３カ月連続の下落から反転し、１．２％上昇した。食品の大半はトラックで輸送されており、９月の急伸は過去最高水準にあるディーゼル燃料価格が経済全般に波及し始めている初期の兆候である可能性がある。

オックスフォード・エコノミクスの米国担当チーフエコノミスト、マイケル・ピアース氏は「今は財政政策による下支え効果がないため、ガソリン価格の上昇で家計が打撃を受け始めている」と指摘。「ディーゼル価格の上昇は、向こう数カ月で広範な財やサービスの一段の値上げにつながるとみている」と述べた。

変動が激しい食品とエネルギーを除くモノのコア指数は０．３％上昇。８月は０．４％上昇していた。

サービス価格は０．８％上昇。８月は０．２％上昇だった。卸売業者と小売業者が受け取るマージンが１．４％上昇したことが、サービス業全般の上昇の半分近くを占めた。

トラックによる貨物輸送、ホテル・モーテルなどの宿泊料金、航空運賃も上昇した。一方、自動車燃料・潤滑油の小売マージンは３０．３％急落。証券仲介の価格も下落した。

エコノミストは９月の米個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格のコア指数が、前月比０．３５％上昇し、四捨五入ベースで０．４％に達する可能性があると試算。前年同月比では３．１％上昇との見通しを示した。８月のコアＰＣＥインフレ率は前月比０．２％、前年同月比３．０％上昇だった。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：米移民摘発、過去最高の逮捕件数も送還難航　法的手続きや移送能力に壁 コラム：米財務省の借入拡大、債務問題の大きさに比べれば単なるノイズ 焦点：テスラ、ロボタクシー「サイバーキャブ」で試す規制の限界 コラム：日銀利上げの「美しいシナリオ」に弱点はないか＝上野泰也氏 コラム：日米協調介入が告げる円高への転換、円安派は今こそ見直しの時 最終更新: 10/16(金) 3:01 ロイター

item.title: Huracán Trudy cobra fuerza frente a costa de México golpeada por lluvias
item.description: El huracán Trudy se seguía fortaleciendo el jueves sobre el océano Pacífico, a medida que enfilaba hacia la costa occidental de México, amenazando con dejar más lluvias y fuertes vientos en una zona castigada en las últimas semanas por varios ciclones tropicales que dejaron inundaciones y víctimas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El huracán Trudy se seguía fortaleciendo el jueves sobre el océano Pacífico, a medida que enfilaba hacia la costa occidental de México, amenazando con dejar más lluvias y fuertes vientos en una zona castigada en las últimas semanas por varios ciclones tropicales que dejaron inundaciones y víctimas. A las 17.00 hora local (2300 GMT), el ciclón se ubicaba a unos 380 kilómetros al sur-suroeste de la ciudad portuaria Acapulco, en el estado Guerrero, y soplaba vientos máximos sostenidos de 150 kilómetros por hora (km/h), con ráfagas más fuertes, mientras avanzaba hacia el norte-noroeste a 9 km/h, según el más reciente reporte del Centro Nacional de Huracanes de Estados Unidos (NHC, por su sigla en inglés). Se espera que Trudy se siga intensificando rápidamente hasta convertirse cerca del mediodía del viernes en un huracán de categoría 4 en la escala de Saffir-Simpson. Un ciclón de ese nivel puede soplar vientos máximos sostenidos de hasta 250 km/h y causar daños generalizados en estructuras protectoras, desplome de tejados en edificios pequeños, erosión de bancales y playas e inundaciones en terrenos interiores. "Si Trudy se intensifica como se pronostica, los fuertes vientos cerca de su centro generarán olas peligrosamente altas en altamar. El oleaje se extenderá hacia afuera, amenazando tanto a embarcaciones pequeñas como a grandes buques", advirtió AccuWeather, una compañía estadounidense de servicios comerciales de pronóstico del tiempo. Si bien no se prevé que Trudy toque tierra, descargará lluvias torrenciales y dejará fuertes ráfagas de viento y oleaje peligroso en la franja costera que va desde el conocido destino turístico Acapulco hasta Puerto Vallarta, pasando por los dos mayores puertos del país: Manzanillo y Lázaro Cárdenas, puerta de entrada principal para mercancías provenientes de Asia. Por la tarde del jueves, pescadores recogían sus embarcaciones en Acapulco y las aseguraban en la arena en previsión de tempestades. Autoridades exhortaron a la población a extremar precauciones y cerraron algunos puertos pesqueros y turísticos a la navegación de embarcaciones menores. "La gravedad de las condiciones en la costa mexicana provocadas por Trudy dependerá de si el ojo del huracán alcanza la costa o si, por el contrario, la tormenta roza la línea costera. Una diferencia de trayectoria de entre 80 y 160 kilómetros podría tener consecuencias muy diferentes", agregó AccuWeather. En las últimas semanas, la costa del Pacífico mexicano fue golpeada por los huracanes [USN:L6N45L0YK TEXT:"Polo"] y [USN:L8N45V0SM TEXT:"Simón"]. Si bien este último tampoco tocó tierra, sigue activo, aunque como tormenta tropical, frente a la costa centroccidental del país.

item.title: 米9月小売売上高0.8％増、ガソリン高で予想上回る伸び コアは減速
item.description:
Lucia Mutikani
[ワシントン １５日 ロイター] - 米商務省が１５日発表した９月の小売売上高（季節調整...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米9月小売売上高0.8％増、ガソリン高で予想上回る伸び　コアは減速 10/15 22:45 配信

２０２５年１１月、米ワシントン州で撮影　REUTERS/David Ryder

Lucia Mutikani

[ワシントン　１５日　ロイター] - 米商務省が１５日発表した９月の小売売上高（季節調整済）は前月比０．８％増加した。ガソリン価格の上昇を背景に予想を上回る伸びとなった。ただ、ガソリン以外の支出は総じて緩やかで、個人消費が力強く拡大した前四半期の勢いが今後も続くとのエコノミストの見方に水を差す可能性がある。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は０．３％増。予想レンジは横ばいから０．７％増まで幅があった。

９月の小売売上高の増加分の大半はガソリン価格の上昇によるものだった。米エネルギー情報局（ＥＩＡ）によると、９月のガソリン価格は７．１％上昇した。

９月の自動車、ガソリン、建設資材、外食サービスを除くコア小売売上高は前月比０．１％増。伸びは８月の１．２％から減速したほか、エコノミスト予想の０．３％を下回った。

ガソリンスタンドの売上高は６．４％急増。自動車販売店の売上高は０．２％増だった。家具、電化製品、オンライン小売店の売上高も増加した。

唯一のサービス部門である飲食店の売上高は１．１％増と、８月の１．４％増から鈍化した。建材・園芸用品、スポーツ用品・趣味・楽器・書籍店の売上高は減少した。その他小売店の売上高は３．０％減だった。

８月の小売売上高は１．３％増に上方改定された。国勢調査局は先月、過去の統計修正や新たに利用可能となった調査データを反映させるため、小売売上高の推計値を改定。８月は当初１．２％増と報告されたが、その後１．１％増に下方修正されていた。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：米移民摘発、過去最高の逮捕件数も送還難航　法的手続きや移送能力に壁 コラム：米財務省の借入拡大、債務問題の大きさに比べれば単なるノイズ 焦点：テスラ、ロボタクシー「サイバーキャブ」で試す規制の限界 コラム：日銀利上げの「美しいシナリオ」に弱点はないか＝上野泰也氏 コラム：日米協調介入が告げる円高への転換、円安派は今こそ見直しの時 最終更新: 10/16(金) 0:57 ロイター

BANGKOK, Oct 15 : Japan told its G20 counterparts that authorities must watch exchange-rate moves with a high sense of urgency, Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said on Thursday. The G20 finance leaders re-confirmed their commitment on currency policy, Katayama told reporters after attending the group's gathering, held on the sidelines of the annual IMF meetings in Bangkok this week. "I told the gathering that we must closely watch financial market developments with a high sense of urgency," Katayama said on Japan's exchange-rate policy. The remarks came as the yen's persistent weakness keeps market players on alert over the chance of another round of intervention by authorities to prop up the currency.

The G20 agrees that exchange-rate moves should be determined by markets but that excessively volatile and disorderly moves were undesirable - a line Japan points to as giving it authority to step into the market to arrest unwelcome yen swings. A weak yen has become a source of concern for Japanese policymakers by pushing up the cost of imports, including for fuel, which has spiked due to the Middle East war. Katayama said the G20 finance leaders did not produce a joint communique or a chair's statement during their meeting on Thursday. When asked about the G20 group's discussions around rising long-term interest rates, Katayama said she told the group that each country must strive to achieve its fiscal sustainability goals, but at the same time use fiscal scope to boost investment in growth areas. .

item.title: Market selloff, rising rates test AI data centre deal boom
item.description: A market selloff is forcing companies driving the global AI boom to delay fundraising plans or pay more for capital as investors demand proof they can absorb rising interest rates and computing-power costs.
item.dc:creator: Yantoultra Ngui, Kane Wu, Clare Jim
item.content:encoded: A [USN:L6N4610C5 TEXT:"market selloff"] is forcing companies driving the global AI boom to delay fundraising plans or pay more for capital as investors demand proof they can absorb rising interest rates and computing-power costs. The shift comes as investors reassess whether the companies racing to build the infrastructure underpinning artificial intelligence can generate returns that justify soaring spending on computing power, land and energy. In the past week alone, as AI-related stocks have weakened and the debt of data-centre operator [USN:L8N4610AR TEXT:"CoreWeave"] has slumped towards distressed prices, listings for a Blackstone-backed [USN:L4N45Z0H4 TEXT:"AirTrunk"] REIT, Nvidia-backed [USN:L1N45U12T TEXT:"Firmus"] and SoftBank-backed [USN:L6N45H0SG TEXT:"SB Energy"] have either been pulled or paused. The increased scrutiny is not derailing investment in the sector, analysts said, but it is forcing investors to distinguish more sharply between business models and levels of execution risk. "The conversation has shifted from growth at any cost to a much sharper focus on quality," said Harry Evans, a partner at law firm Freshfields. Evans said deal activity could hold up through next year, thanks to a strong pipeline. Recent listing setbacks, however, show investors are becoming more discerning about valuations, leverage and business models. M&A involving Asian data centres is still on track for a record year, reaching $21.3 billion as of Tuesday, according to Dealogic data, more than double the $10 billion recorded in all of 2025. Debt financing has also remained strong, with syndicated loans and bond issuance totalling $22.3 billion so far this year. Equity capital market fundraising for the sector, however, is down, at $5.4 billion so far this year, a 4.6% drop from the same period in 2025. "General thoughts with IPOs are that they often seek 'hype', as they're largely looking for oversubscription," said Nicholas Tuan, director, APAC Advisory Services at real estate services firm Savills. "There may not be fundamental asset value when you peel it all back." Firmus, which had aimed to raise $5 billion in what would have been Australia's second-largest stock market listing, struggled to convince investors it could deliver on ambitious revenue projections while carrying about $30 billion of debt. Nuclear services company [USN:L4N4581N6 TEXT:"Holtec"] cited a "[USN:L4N45H14U TEXT:"perfect storm"]", driven mainly by uncertainty around data-centre demand, when it pulled its US listing last month. HIGHER RATES TEST VALUATIONS Higher borrowing costs are at the heart of the new scrutiny. Benchmark 10-year US Treasury yields posted their sharpest quarterly rise this century last month, prompting investors to take a closer look at whether projected revenues can support growing debt burdens, bankers said. Gary Goh, CEO of Sprint DC Consulting, an Asia-Pacific data centre consultancy firm based in Kuala Lumpur, warned higher financing costs could lead to sharp valuation corrections. Valuations can vary widely depending on whether they are based on existing customer contracts or future projections, and whether capital expenditure requirements are fully reflected, said a banker who advises data-centre investors. "There is not remotely enough data centres built for the demand," said the banker, who was not authorised to speak publicly. "Investors are still going in but the question is at what valuation." Investors are also paying closer attention to execution risks. Beyond higher power and water costs, developers face [USN:L1N45M0CN TEXT:"growing opposition"] in some markets over electricity use, noise and environmental concerns, adding to regulatory uncertainty around new projects. Securing suitable land and power supplies is becoming more difficult in some jurisdictions, said a person at a US-based firm that invests in Asian data-centre platforms, adding that the company had tightened its underwriting criteria because of geopolitical and policy risks. To be sure, major transactions are still [USN:L6N460198 TEXT:"moving ahead"]. Singapore-based DayOne is expected to go public as soon as November, seeking to raise up to $5 billion, Reuters [USN:L6N45H0SG TEXT:"reported"] in September. DayOne did not immediately respond to a request for comment. AirTrunk, despite postponing a planned REIT listing, is nearing a deal to sell its Johor data centre in Malaysia to a group of investors including local pension fund KWAP at a valuation of about $1 billion, according to two people familiar with the matter. Bain Capital has also received final bids for at least 40% of its pan-Asian platform Bridge Data Centres in a deal that could value the business at around $5 billion, according to two people with knowledge of the process. AirTrunk's backer Blackstone and Bain Capital declined to comment. KWAP said it was not in a position to comment. Still, investors are likely to differentiate between established wholesale operators with long-term customer commitments and stable revenue, and higher-risk "neoclouds" and "AI-campus builders", said John Dinsdale, chief analyst at TechInsights. "The question for investors is less whether demand will expand than which business models and companies will be best placed to capture that growth sustainably."

FAST

BANGKOK, Oct 15 : The United States wants its global partners to rename artificial intelligence as "super intelligence," convinced that the new moniker better reflects the emerging technology, a top US Treasury official told Reuters in an interview on Thursday. Treasury Undersecretary for International Affairs Erin Browne said Washington was in negotiations with other shareholders of the International Monetary Fund about using the new term in a statement being drafted by the fund's steering committee, the International Monetary and Financial Committee. US President Donald Trump last month directed US government agencies to use the words "super intelligence" instead of "artificial intelligence" when referring to the technology. Browne said the United States, which holds the rotating presidency of the Group of 20 major economies, wanted the change to take hold internationally as well.

"President Trump has been really clear on this, and he's, you know, using the term SI, and I think it's a clear priority for the US to use that term, and we think that more appropriately encapsulates the technology at hand," Browne said. She declined to comment on whether Washington would refuse to sign off on the statement unless the switch was made. "We're still in the middle of negotiations on that statement, so I'm not going to, you know, sort of run ahead of that," she said. A source familiar with the matter said US officials had suggested during meetings on the IMFC statement that they would insist on the new language, raising eyebrows among some other IMFC members. If Washington withholds its support for a consensus statement, the current IMFC chair, Saudi Finance Minister Mohammed Al-Jadaan, could still issue a so-called chair's statement summarizing the views of the members. One possibility might involve skipping a mention of SI or AI and focusing on "new technology" instead, the source said. The IMFC will hold a news conference and release any agreed statement led by Al-Jadaan and IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva on Saturday. "We see this as a driving force behind American growth and global growth," Browne said. "Many countries are looking to the US to set the standards, as well as to set the path forward for SI development and how that can really enhance and boost growth and productivity on a global basis."

Source: Reuters

item.title: 「カルティエ」のリシュモン、デビアス買収連合参加へ協議＝関係筋
item.description:
Clara Denina Olivia Kumwenda-Mtambo
［ロンドン／ヨハネスブルグ １５日 ロイター］...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
「カルティエ」のリシュモン、デビアス買収連合参加へ協議＝関係筋 10/15 21:30 配信

ダイヤモンド展示、デビアスの施設で2015年撮影 REUTERS/Siphiwe Sibeko

Clara Denina　Olivia Kumwenda-Mtambo

［ロンドン／ヨハネスブルグ　１５日　ロイター］ - 「カルティエ」や「ヴァンクリーフ＆アーペル」などを持つスイスの高級ブランド大手リシュモンが、英資源大手アングロ・アメリカンが売却を進めているダイヤモンド採掘大手デビアスの買収コンソーシアム（企業連合）に参加する方向で協議している。事情に詳しい関係者が明らかにした。

買収が実現すれば、リシュモンは、ダイヤのサプライチェーン（供給網）の重要部分に対する影響力を強化できる。

アングロは、ダイヤモンド価格の下落や人工ダイヤモンドの需要拡大を受け、大規模な事業再編の一環として２０２４年５月にデビアスを売りに出した。

デビアスの評価額は約１０億ドルとされている。ブルームバーグの報道によると、リシュモンは、デビアスのギャレス・ペニー元最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が率いる企業連合「グローバル・ダイヤモンド・コンソーシアム」への参加について協議している。協議は進展しているものの、リシュモンが企業連合に参加する確証はないという。

デビアスについては、ボツワナが優先交渉権を有する。同国政府は権利を行使するかどうかをまだ明らかにしていない。ボツワナ大統領府の報道官は１３日、合意が成立して署名されるまで政府としてコメントしないと述べた。

Oct 15 : Anthropic should delay its US IPO until it addresses concerns about safety, governance and the pace of development, urged New York City Comptroller Mark Levine in a letter to the AI lab's CEO Dario Amodei. AI systems have advanced rapidly over the past 12 months, outpacing regulation and drawing scrutiny over potential risks, including safety, cybersecurity threats and misuse. "Instead of proceeding headlong with its IPO, the company should focus its energies on addressing these unprecedented risks," Levine wrote in the letter seen by Reuters on Thursday. NYC's public pension funds have a combined $7 million in exposure to Anthropic through private equity holdings, the comptroller's office told Reuters.

Anthropic, which is reportedly targeting a $2 trillion valuation in the listing, did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment. Anthropic's own research has highlighted the risks posed by increasingly autonomous AI models, which have demonstrated potentially harmful capabilities in controlled tests, including sabotaging code, facilitating fraud and manipulating information. Earlier this week, in a pre-IPO meeting, Anthropic told prospective investors that revenue in the third quarter surged 45 per cent from the prior quarter, Reuters reported, citing sources. Its closest rival, ChatGPT maker OpenAI, is expected to list in 2027. New York City's comptroller oversees the city's finances, manages its pension funds and acts as a watchdog over public spending and financial practices. The funds have over $325 billion in assets. The contents of the letter were first reported by CNBC, earlier on Thursday.

Source: Reuters

item.title: ソースネクスト、2251万件の情報流出の可能性
item.description: ［東京 １５日 ロイター］ - ソースネクストは１５日、第三者による不正アクセスで顧客の個人情報が最大２２５１万件...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ソースネクスト、2251万件の情報流出の可能性 10/15 20:10 配信

［東京　１５日　ロイター］ - ソースネクストは１５日、第三者による不正アクセスで顧客の個人情報が最大２２５１万件流出した可能性があると公表した。

対象となる情報はメールアドレス、パスワード、住所、氏名、電話番号など。クレジットカード情報は含まれていないという。

１３日午前９時に会員情報を管理するシステムに不正アクセスがあったことを確認。直ちに外部からの不正な通信を遮断するなどの措置を講じ、１３日午後１時３６分までに不正アクセスの封じ込めを完了しているという。

item.title: ＡＩで金融システミックリスク、ベアメタル復旧必要＝英中銀副総裁
item.description:
Rae Wee Phoebe Seers
[バンコク／ロンドン １５日 ロイター] - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＡＩで金融システミックリスク、ベアメタル復旧必要＝英中銀副総裁 10/15 19:40 配信

ロンドンのイングランド銀行本部、9月16日撮影 REUTERS/Corey Rudy

Rae Wee　Phoebe Seers

[バンコク／ロンドン １５日 ロイター] - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）のブリーデン副総裁は１５日、深刻なサイバー攻撃を受けた場合の復旧策について、銀行と協力して検討していると明らかにした。

同氏は人工知能（ＡＩ）を使ったサイバー攻撃を防御できると想定することはできないと指摘、ＡＩの進歩は世界の金融インフラに「システミックリスク」をもたらす水準に達したと警告した。

バンコクで開かれた国際金融協会（ＩＩＦ）の年次総会で「サイバー攻撃による侵入を防げると想定するだけでは十分ではない。中核サービスに必要な『ベアメタル復旧』の選択肢を検討する必要がある。金融システム全体を通じて、これを考えなければならない」と述べた。

いわゆる「ベアメタル」システムは、銀行の主要な技術基盤から完全に独立しており、主要システムが侵害された場合に稼働できる。

世界の銀行規制当局は、拡大するＡＩリスクの抑制に向けた取り組みを強化している。ロイターは１３日、英国でも監督当局が大手銀行にベアメタル復旧計画の検討を促していると報じた。

ブリーデン氏は、ＡＩの発展により、大規模で複雑なサイバー攻撃のリスクが高まっていると警告。「サイバーセキュリティーの基本的な対策が、これまで以上に重要になっている」と述べた。

「夜も眠れなくなる懸念は何かと聞かれれば、いつもサイバー問題だと答えている。最も心配しているのは、目覚めた時に、金融システム上極めて重要な銀行の一つや中核インフラの一部が攻撃を受け、まひしていることだ」と語った。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：債務膨張の先進国に金融危機の芽、最も懸念される米・伊・英 アングル：ＡＩエージェントの「暴走リスク」現実に、見直し迫られるサイバー保険 アングル：英新財務相、実務手腕に一定評価も支出拡大・増税不安消えず アングル：英国経済、ＥＵ離脱から10年の軌跡 アングル：ブレグジット10年、英ＥＵの溝なお深く　極右台頭も重し 最終更新: 10/15(木) 19:40 ロイター

item.title: Israeli firm used online ads to run vast spy operation, researchers say
item.description: Israeli digital advertising agency Discover-Tech spied on internet users through a sprawling network of online ads that it used to track targets and help hack their devices, two research groups said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Raphael Satter
item.content:encoded: Israeli digital advertising agency Discover-Tech spied on internet users through a sprawling network of online ads that it used to track targets and help hack their devices, two research groups said on Thursday. Its services gave Israel's Candiru — a spyware company [USN:L1N2RU186 TEXT:"blacklisted by the US government"] — as well as other Israeli surveillance firms access to advertising platforms run by Google (GOOGL.O) , Comcast (CMCSA.O) , Russia's Yandex and others, according to separate reports from Canadian cyber watchdog group Citizen Lab and New York advertising security firm Confiant. The reports show how the online advertising business, long a subject of privacy concerns, can also serve as a channel for sweeping espionage campaigns. "The way online advertising works today is a systemic security threat," Wolfie Christl, a senior researcher at Citizen Lab, told Reuters. "For states, the private sector, civil society and everyone else alike." Discover-Tech's online ads — often for ordinary products such as phones or earbuds — reached more than 120,000 websites and 75,000 apps through its various partnerships, Citizen Lab said. Users who visited sites or used apps with the malicious ads could be identified and tracked by Discover-Tech, which would sometimes also try to extract phone numbers from some smartphone users, the researchers said. Ads only needed to load on a website for the spying to occur. Some ads would be used to help plant spyware from Candiru on users' devices, both research groups said, though Confiant said that ads it tied to Candiru were a tiny fraction of Discover-Tech's overall volume. MALICIOUS ADS SHOWN IN HUNDREDS OF SENSITIVE NETWORKS Confiant cofounder Jerome Dangu said Discover-Tech was pumping out at least 10 million ads per day all around the world and that data-sharing arrangements — called cookie matching — allowed it to track people even beyond the reach of its advertisements. "Very likely hundreds of millions of people would have been touched by Discover-Tech," Dangu said. Discover-Tech, which was founded in 2020, did not return messages left via its contact form. A LinkedIn message and emails sent to its chief executive, Dekel Boni, were not returned. Reuters' attempts to reach Candiru's owners were similarly unsuccessful. The US Commerce Department blacklisted Candiru in 2021 for [USN:L1N2RU186 TEXT:"allegedly supplying spyware"] that was used to maliciously target government officials, journalists, activists and academics. Citizen Lab said a powerful form of Candiru spyware delivered through Discover-Tech's ads had been used to compromise 45 Windows devices at the Qatari broadcaster Al Jazeera between 2024 and 2025, something it said it was able to confirm because the media group had shared its network logs with the group. In a statement, Al Jazeera said it "condemns the spyware attacks targeting a number of its staff" and that it was taking steps to protect its employees and its systems. "Those responsible must be held accountable," it said. Dangu of Confiant said that the malicious ads had been shown to users in "hundreds of networks in sensitive categories," including the Pentagon, the International Atomic Energy Agency, and the International Criminal Court. He also said that some regions, like the Palestinian territories, were particularly saturated by the Israeli firm's ads. "You go to almost any site in Palestine — any site — you find a Discover-Tech ad. It gives them a very complete visibility on the digital activities of an entire country," he said. Citizen Lab also said it had similar evidence showing the malicious ads were shown to people in the United Nations, NATO, the European Commission, and more than a dozen national governments. Other networks the ads appeared in included chip-related firms such as Nvidia (NVDA.O) , Sandisk (SNDK.O) , Broadcom (AVGO.O) , and Micron (MU.O) , as well as several media organizations in Mexico, Israel, and Europe that were not identified. In addition to identifying Candiru and a couple of other surveillance vendors, Citizen Lab said it was able to glean some details about where Discover-Tech's users might be based because the firm inadvertently exposed its authentication logs to the internet, showing people logging in from internet protocol addresses in Israel, Europe, and the Gulf. MEASURES AGAINST DISCOVER-TECH TAKEN Discover-Tech is now being frozen out of parts of the online ad market. Google said in a statement that it had collaborated with Citizen Lab and Confiant's investigation and kicked Discover-Tech off its ad platforms "for systematically violating our policies." IAB Europe, the European-level association for the digital marketing and advertising ecosystem, said in an email that Discover-Tech had been suspended from its list of globally approved vendors last week after an audit identified policy violations. Comcast ad tech subsidiary Beeswax removed Discover-Tech from its platform "following recent activity," Comcast said in a statement. Yandex did not return Reuters messages seeking comment. Advertising-driven surveillance is increasingly being seen as a national security threat. Earlier this year, the Pentagon said it had received reports that US forces deployed to war zones had been [USN:L6N4240BC TEXT:"targeted using location data"] harvested by ad tech firms and data brokers. Branches of the military have since [USN:L6N44V02G TEXT:"disabled ad tracking"] on some devices.

item.title: Tesla unveils next generation Roadster sports EV with SpaceX thrusters
item.description: Tesla unveiled a redesigned Roadster equipped with thrusters on Thursday, nearly nine years after it first showed a next-generation version of its electric sports car and said it would start production in 2028.
item.dc:creator: Abhirup Roy
item.content:encoded: Tesla (TSLA.O) unveiled a redesigned Roadster equipped with thrusters on Thursday, nearly nine years after it first showed a next-generation version of its electric sports car and said it would start production in 2028. Tesla demonstrated the two-seater vehicle, developed in collaboration with CEO Elon Musk's rocket company SpaceX, showing it driving upside down on a ramp using a suction system and turning in the air and landing using in-built thrusters. The use and legality of such features on public roads were not immediately clear. Musk has played down the car's importance to Tesla's finances, describing it in 2023 as a "small potato situation" that would not "move the needle in a major way financially." But the car still carries symbolic weight. "Tesla does not currently have a halo car, or high-performance luxury vehicle designed to showcase an automaker's best engineering and technology. The Roadster will be Tesla's new halo car," Morningstar analyst Seth Goldstein said in a note last month. Musk and other executives did not specify any target prices at Thursday's event, although Tesla nearly a decade ago quoted a base price of $200,000 for the vehicle. Tesla's reservation page for the Roadster after Thursday's event showed a "Performance" version of the vehicle requiring a $50,000 deposit and a "Thrust" version with "acceleration thrusters" requiring a $250,000 deposit. A "Rocket" variant, which Tesla says is "invite only", is described as a single-seat model with a "full flight system". The Roadster can accelerate from zero to 60 miles per hour in less than one second and can hit a top speed of over 230 mph, Musk said at a SpaceX test site in McGregor, Texas. Tesla revealed a prototype of the car in 2017 and said then that deliveries would begin in 2020. Musk had set high expectations in 2017, saying a four-seat Roadster would travel 620 miles (1,000 km) on a single charge. Goldstein expects Tesla to sell around 2,000 Roadsters a year — a fraction of the 1.6 million vehicles Tesla sold last year. The original Roadster, released in 2008 and on sale until 2012, was Tesla's first-ever EV and used a Lotus Elise chassis. It helped change the world's view of what an electric vehicle could be. The company has since been known for its Model Y and Model X SUVs and Model S and Model 3 sedans. The reveal of the second-generation Roadster also comes amid a sharp shift in Tesla's focus to artificial intelligence-led self-driving tech and robotics, from manufacturing cars for human drivers. This year, Tesla stopped selling Model S and X vehicles to make space for production of its Optimus humanoid robots. It also launched Cybercab - a two-seater robotaxi that comes without manual controls such as a steering wheel, pedals and mirrors.

item.title: AstraZeneca strikes $40 million AI drug discovery deal with insitro
item.description: AstraZeneca has teamed up with artificial intelligence biotech company insitro to discover and develop new treatments for difficult to treat liver and heart conditions, the British drugmaker said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Patrick Wingrove
item.content:encoded: AstraZeneca (AZN.L) has teamed up with artificial intelligence biotech company insitro to discover and develop new treatments for difficult to treat liver and heart conditions, the British drugmaker said on Thursday. Under the agreement, AstraZeneca will pay $40 million up front, with California-based insitro eligible for up to about $1.46 billion in potential development and commercial milestones, as well as a single-digit percentage of future sales in royalties. The multi-year collaboration will focus on metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), a severe liver disease, and cardiomyopathies, a group of diseases that affect the heart muscle. Both have historically lacked effective therapies because researchers have struggled to pinpoint their root biological drivers, the drugmaker said. Insitro will use its "Virtual Human" AI platform, which combines lab-grown cell models and machine learning, to identify causal disease biology and advance AstraZeneca-nominated targets from discovery to development-candidate stage. AstraZeneca will then run and fund future clinical trials. The deal builds on insitro's expansion across the pharmaceuticals industry. The biotech company recently expanded its partnership with Bristol Myers Squibb (BMY.N) to advance a broader portfolio of targets for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). It also teamed up with Eli Lilly (LLY.N) to build AI models that predict pharmacological properties of small molecules in living organisms. "Choosing the new targets that we want to put into our discovery pipeline is one of the hardest things we do across research and development," Sharon Barr, executive vice president of biopharmaceuticals R&D at AstraZeneca, told Reuters. "By the time we read about a new pathway or target (in major scientific journals), it is no longer novel. It's in the public domain and we're already a few steps too late. But when we identify these unique connections early and test them in cellular systems, we're ahead of the game." Barr added that pairing AI tools with experienced scientists allows the company to test fewer molecules in the lab, reduce guesswork and speed the search for effective medicines.

item.content:encoded:

Two ships ablaze in Romanian Black Sea waters, 7 sailors missing

A cargo ship is pictured in the Black Sea in Krapets, on Oct 14, 2026, a day after suspected Russian drones struck two cargo ships off Bulgaria, sinking one vessel and leaving 11 sailors missing in the latest spillover from the Ukraine war in the Black Sea. (Photo: AFP/Nikolay Doychinov)

BUCHAREST: Rescuers were searching for seven missing crew on Thursday (Oct 15) from one of two chemical tankers that caught fire overnight inside Romanian territorial waters in the Black Sea, after Russian drones strayed into Romanian airspace, Romanian officials said. Romanian officials stopped short of explicitly linking the fires onboard the ships to the Russian drones. But the incidents follow drone strikes on at least five other cargo ships near the coasts of Romania and neighbouring fellow NATO member Bulgaria over the past 10 days. At least 23 sailors were lost from those strikes, which unlike the latest incidents took place just outside NATO's territorial waters. The two ships hit overnight were both anchored in the Black Sea near the mouth of the canal leading into the Danube River, a major shipping route used by Ukraine as Russia has attacked Ukraine's own Black Sea ports. Romania's naval authority said it received an emergency alert from the San Marino-flagged tanker Wine Trader. Seven of its 12 crew were missing and 5 were rescued.

The interior ministry said it had sent two Black Hawk helicopters to the search and rescue mission, as well as two ships with medical staff on board. "At the moment, the rescue cannot be done safely because of very big waves," it said in a statement. Late on Wednesday, the Comoros-flagged chemical and oil tanker Yara J also caught fire. Romanian authorities initially said it was not clear whether it had been attacked. All its crew were safe. Romania shares a 614km border with Ukraine, much of it along the Danube. It has reported repeated breaches of its airspace by Russian drones over the past four years. Both Wine Trader and Yara J caught fire near the mouth of the Danube River's Sulina Canal leading to the Black Sea, where ships often anchor waiting to pass because of delays from weather and congestion. Increasing attacks on Black Sea shipping connected with the Russia-Ukraine war in recent months have threatened to cause a global food crisis, as both countries are major exporters of grain, as is Romania. "We're looking at the Black Sea as a global food artery," Romanian Foreign Minister Oana Toiu told a security conference in Warsaw earlier this week. "It is currently, unfortunately, the deadliest sea when it comes to the number of casualties of sailors in the last months. That means we need to increase our investments in deterrence, defence." Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev said EU leaders would discuss on Thursday a proposed moratorium on attacks on civilian ships in the Black Sea. Russia has been bombing Ukraine's Black Sea ports, forcing Kyiv to rely increasingly on Danube River ports and shipping routes close to the coasts of Bulgaria and Romania. For its part, Ukraine has targeted Russian ships near the mouth of the Don River in the Azov Sea.

Source: Reuters/ec

item.title: 金融調節は日銀に委ねるべき、リフレ政策採る状況ではない＝城内経財相
item.description:
Rocky Swift Makiko Yamazaki
[東京 １５日 ロイター] - 城内実経済財政相は１５日、金融...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
金融調節は日銀に委ねるべき、リフレ政策採る状況ではない＝城内経財相 10/15 18:27 配信

城内実経済財政相。都内で9月撮影。 REUTERS/Manami Yamada

Rocky Swift　Makiko Yamazaki

[東京 １５日 ロイター] - 城内実経済財政相は１５日、金融政策調節は日銀に委ねるべきだとし、中央銀行の独立性を尊重する政府の立場を改めて示した。市場では追加利上げの見通しを見極める動きが続いている。

城内氏はＬＳＥＧが主催した「ロイターネクスト・ニュースメーカー」で、一般論として政府は２％の物価目標の達成に向けた金融政策運営は日銀に委ねられていると理解していると指摘。その上で、金融調節は日銀に「しっかり委ねることが大事だ」と語った。

城内氏は過去に利上げに慎重な姿勢を示したことや、景気刺激策を支持する議員グループとの関係から、市場ではリフレ派と見なされることが多い。しかし、日本はもはやリフレ政策を採用するような状況にはなく、高市政権はそうした政策を決して進めていないと述べた。

日本経済については「成長志向の新たな経済へと移行しつつある」と述べ、長年のデフレで形成された認識ではなく現状に基づき評価するよう世界の投資家に呼びかけた。

「日本経済は、長年のデフレ期とはもはや同じではない。こうした変化する現実に基づいて日本を評価してもらいたい」と指摘。「今こそ日本に投資する時だと考えている」と述べた。

城内氏は、成長のほか財政の持続可能性も重視する姿勢を示し、高市政権下での財政支出拡大を警戒する投資家の懸念払拭を図った。「『積極財政』という言葉を聞いて、単に財政規律の緩和を意味すると受け止める人もいるかもしれないが、われわれが目指しているのはそういうことではない」と述べた。

戦略的投資で日本の潜在成長力が高まれば、財政の持続可能性を維持しながら、賃金や所得、税収の増加につなげられると語った。

item.title: 英企業のコスト削減、インフレ抑制を後押し＝英中銀副総裁
item.description: [１５日 ロイター] - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）のブリーデン副総裁は１５日、イラン戦争によるエネルギー価格高...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英企業のコスト削減、インフレ抑制を後押し＝英中銀副総裁 10/15 18:25 配信

イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）のブリーデン副総裁。ロンドンで7月代表撮影。 REUTERS

[１５日 ロイター] - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）のブリーデン副総裁は１５日、イラン戦争によるエネルギー価格高騰への対応として英企業がコスト削減に取り組んでいることで、中銀はインフレを抑えやすくなるとの見方を示した。

ＣＮＢＣテレビのインタビューで「前回エネルギー価格が急騰した２０２２年と大きく異なるのは、人々がコストを価格に転嫁しようとしていない点だ」と指摘した。

「単に価格に転嫁するのではなく、ショックを吸収しようとしている。このため、先行きが不透明な中でも、われわれにとって金融政策の運営がいくらか容易になる」と語った。

国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）・世界銀行総会に出席するためバンコクを訪れているブリーデン氏は、現在は労働市場が弱いため、ロシアがウクライナへの全面侵攻を始めた２２年のような急激な賃金上昇は起きないことを期待しているとも述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：債務膨張の先進国に金融危機の芽、最も懸念される米・伊・英 アングル：英新財務相、実務手腕に一定評価も支出拡大・増税不安消えず アングル：英国経済、ＥＵ離脱から10年の軌跡 アングル：ブレグジット10年、英ＥＵの溝なお深く　極右台頭も重し 焦点：ＥＵ離脱から10年、苦闘続く英輸出企業　非離脱シナリオより低成長の予測 最終更新: 10/15(木) 18:25 ロイター

item.title: ノルウェー政府系ファンド、防衛大手への投資容認を委員会が提言
item.description:
Gwladys Fouche
[オスロ １５日 ロイター] - ノルウェー政府が設置した委員会は１５日、世界最大の政府...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ノルウェー政府系ファンド、防衛大手への投資容認を委員会が提言 10/15 18:12 配信

Gwladys Fouche

[オスロ １５日 ロイター] - ノルウェー政府が設置した委員会は１５日、世界最大の政府系ファンドであるノルウェー政府年金基金（ＳＷＦ）について、欧米の大手防衛企業への投資を認めるべきだと提言した。これらの企業は核兵器製造に関わっているとして、現在は投資対象から除外されている。

政府と議会が承認すれば、防衛企業への投資額は数百億ドルに上る可能性がある。

現行の規定では、核兵器製造に関与しているとして、欧州エアバス、米ボーイング、ロッキード・マーチン、英ＢＡＥシステムズなどの株式を取得できない。

新規定案では、核拡散防止条約（ＮＰＴ）で核兵器保有国と認められている国（米・英・仏・ロ・中）のうち、北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）加盟国であるノルウェーと同盟関係にある国に本拠を置く企業は除外対象から外す。

委員会は提言で「これにより、核兵器の部品を製造する欧米企業の一部を投資対象に組み入れることが可能になる」と説明した。

ＮＡＴＯ事務総長を務めたストルテンベルグ財務相は、世界の安全保障情勢の変化やノルウェーがＮＡＴＯの「核の傘」に依存していることを理由に、委員会に倫理規定の見直しを求めていた。

投資対象から除外されている防衛関連企業には、このほか仏サフラン、タレス、米ＢＷＸテクノロジーズ、ノースロップ・グラマン、フルア、ゼネラル・ダイナミクス、ハンティントン・インガルス・インダストリーズ、ジェイコブズ・ソリューションズ、Ｌ３ハリス・テクノロジーズ、印Ｌ＆Ｔがある。

ノルウェー赤十字などの市民団体は、こうした見直しは大量破壊兵器への投資を正当化することになると主張している。赤十字は委員会に提出した意見書で「ノルウェーが巨額の資金をどのように投資するかは、世界の基準づくりに影響する」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：中東紛争、サウジ皇太子が「ワイルドカード」　対応読みづらく コラム：海外マネーの中国離れ、習主席はじっとやり過ごすのが得策か アングル：湾岸諸国、インフラ整備に重点投資　ホルムズ海峡封鎖で紛争耐性強化へ アングル：金価格が回復傾向、中銀・機関投資家需要が支援 アングル：中国国債が安全資産に急浮上、イラン停戦でも追い風続く 最終更新: 10/15(木) 18:12 ロイター

item.title: S&P 500 ends higher as traders shift from AI to healthcare
item.description: The S&P 500 ended higher on Thursday, springing back from early losses as investors concerned about AI stocks shifted into Eli Lilly, UnitedHealth and other healthcare and consumer stocks.
item.dc:creator: Noel Randewich, Sruthi Shankar
item.content:encoded: The S&P 500 ended higher on Thursday, springing back from early losses as investors concerned about AI stocks shifted into Eli Lilly, UnitedHealth and other healthcare and consumer stocks. Several technology stocks fell, as investors scrutinized AI-related companies whose debt loads leave them vulnerable to rising interest rates. Drugmaker Eli Lilly (LLY.N) gained over 3%, UnitedHealth (UNH.N) added 2.8% and Walmart rose 1.4% after rating upgrades by Deutsche Bank. Those three companies were heavy contributors to the S&P 500's gain for the session. Nvidia (NVDA.O) dipped 1.8% after chip manufacturer TSMC (2330.TW) struck [USN:L1N461004 TEXT:"a cautious note"] on 2027 despite reporting a sixth consecutive record quarterly profit on robust AI-driven demand. Dell Technologies (DELL.N) dropped 6.9% and Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE.N) fell 7.1%, with both server makers adding to sharp losses in the prior session related to worries about AI companies exposed to higher borrowing costs. The yield on 10-year Treasuries retreated but remained near multiyear highs as investors worried about inflation related to high oil prices. "The cost to finance everything, whether it be a new single-family house or a giant data center, is going up, and that has implications for lots of stuff in the stock market," said Jed Ellerbroek, portfolio manager at Argent Capital Management in St. Louis. "The best performing stocks today are the non-cyclical, defensive businesses." The Philadelphia semiconductor index (.SOX) fell 0.9%, down for a seventh straight session. The S&P 500 climbed 0.33% to end the session at 7,744.06 points. The Nasdaq gained 0.08% to 26,713.03 points, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average rallied 1.08% to 52,177.69 points. Volume on US exchanges was heavy, with 20.7 billion shares traded, compared to an average of 17.6 billion shares over the previous 20 sessions. Eight of the 11 S&P 500 sector indexes rose, led by healthcare (.SPXHC) , up 1.84%, followed by a 1.71% gain in materials (.SPLRCM) . After hitting a record high last week, the S&P 500 remains up about 13% in 2026, with most of that gain fueled by AI-related stocks. The S&P 500 is trading at about 19 times expected earnings, around its lowest level since 2023. The index's relatively low price-to-earnings valuation suggests investors are pricing in an eventual end to the massive earnings growth fueled by AI heavyweights, Ellerbroek said. Data on Thursday showed US producer prices [USN:L1N460127 TEXT:"increased by the most"] in 4-1/2 years in September amid rising goods and services costs, the latest indication of inflation broadening beyond energy products. [USN:L1N45Z121 TEXT:"Hotter-than-expected consumer inflation data"] on Wednesday fueled expectations of further interest-rate hikes by the US Federal Reserve, contributing to a Wall Street selloff. "You've got a little rotation going on in the bigger names, but we've seen this before. It seems this crops up every couple of months and we have the AI concerns," said Joe Saluzzi, co-head of equity trading at Themis Trading in Chatham, New Jersey. Interest rate traders are pricing in a 67% chance the Fed will raise interest rates by its December policy meeting, up from a 62% probability on Wednesday, according to CME's FedWatch tool. Shares of [USN:L4N46023Y TEXT:"Rocket Lab"] (RKLB.O) dropped 6.6% after the space company said the inaugural launch of its new, larger Neutron rocket was delayed until next year. FMC (FMC.N) tumbled over 30% after the agrichemicals company [USN:L4N46114X TEXT:"sharply cut"] its third-quarter outlook. Advancing issues outnumbered falling ones within the S&P 500 (.AD.SPX) by a 3.1-to-1 ratio. The S&P 500 posted 24 new highs and no new lows; the Nasdaq recorded 61 new highs and 393 new lows.

item.title: Pakistan school roof collapse kills 28; more deaths feared
item.description: A rescue official said the ceiling came down on the students after the roof of a higher floor collapsed, crumpling the two storeys.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Pakistan school roof collapse kills 28; more deaths feared

A rescue official said the ceiling came down on the students after the roof of a higher floor collapsed, crumpling the two storeys.

ISLAMABAD: At least 27 students, most younger than 13, were killed in Pakistan on Thursday (Oct 15), along with a teacher, when a school roof collapsed during classes in the northwestern city of Peshawar, authorities said, warning that the death toll could rise. Television images showed ambulances rushing to the site at the privately-run Al-Khair Education Center school while rescuers pulled bloodied students from the rubble. "We have taken out at least 45 children," said district emergency officer Iftikhar Khan, adding that some more children were reported to be buried in the rubble.

Army soldiers and rescue workers gather after a school roof collapse in Peshawar Pakistan, on Oct 15, 2026. (Photo: Reuters)

Rescue teams were working to extricate bodies and take the injured to hospital, said government official Bilal Faizi.

Twenty injured and most of the dead were brought to the city's Lady Reading Hospital, its spokesperson, Mohammad Asim, said. A rescue official said the ceiling came down on the students after the roof of a higher floor collapsed, crumpling the two storeys. Authorities said an investigation had been ordered to determine the cause.

Peshawar police chief Mian Saeed said he feared the death toll could rise as just 47 of the 110 students in three classrooms at the time had been rescued. "It was a weak building structure," Saeed added. "Its roof was overweight with construction on a weak structure that caused the collapse." There was no immediate comment from school officials.
